Do not use it on the face, around the eyes, on mucous membranes, on breaks in the skin such as scratches, on cracked areas, on places where the skin has come away such as scabs, or on inflamed areas (raw skin, areas that are red and swollen). Before using this medicine, patients who are hypersensitive to medicines or cosmetics should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Be careful that it does not get into the eyes; if it does, rinse it out immediately with water. Use this medicine for external use only. Do not touch mucous membranes such as the eyes with hands that have this medicine on them. Do not use it on the face for purposes such as basic skin care.

entries.만 15세 이상은 1회 2캡슐씩, 1일 3회를, 만 8세 이상~만 15세: Those aged 15 years and older take 2 capsules at a time, 3 times a day, and those aged 8 years and older but under 15 years take 1 capsule at a time, 3 times a day, 30 minutes after meals.
entries.만 15세 이상은 1회 2캡슐씩, 만 7세 초과~만 15세 미만은 1회: Those 15 years and older take 2 capsules at a time, and those over 7 years but under 15 years take 1 capsule at a time, 3 times a day, 30 minutes after meals.
entries.만 15세 이상은 1회 2포(12 mL), 만 11세 이상~만 15세 미: Those aged 15 years and older take 2 packets (12 mL) per dose, those aged 11 years to under 15 years take 11/3 packet (8 mL) per dose, those aged 7 years to under 11 years take 1 packet (6 mL) per dose, and those aged 3 years to under 7 years take 2/3 packet (4 mL) per dose. To prevent motion sickness, take 1 dose 30 minutes before boarding, and if an additional dose is needed, take 1 dose with an interval of 4 hours or more. The number of doses a day is limited to 3 times a day.
entries.만 15세 이상은 1회 2포(12 mL)씩, 만 11세 이상~만 15세: Those aged 15 years and over take 2 packets (12 mL) at a time, those aged 11 years and over but under 15 years take 1½ packets (9 mL) at a time, those aged 7 years and over but under 11 years take 1 packet (6 mL) at a time, and those aged 3 years and over but under 7 years take ½ of a packet (3 mL) at a time. To prevent motion sickness, take the single dose for the appropriate age 30 minutes before boarding. If an additional dose is needed, take the single dose for the appropriate age at an interval of at least 4 hours. The number of doses a day is limited to 3.
entries.만 15세 이상은 1회 2포(18 mL), 만 11세 이상～만 15세 미: Those aged 15 years and over take 2 sachets (18 mL) at a time, those aged 11 years and over but under 15 years take 11/3 sachets (12 mL) at a time, those aged 7 years and over but under 11 years take 1 sachet (9 mL) at a time, and those aged 3 years and over but under 7 years take 2/3 sachet (6 mL) at a time; the number of doses is limited to 3 times a day. For the prevention of motion sickness, take it 30 minutes before boarding. If an additional dose is needed, take one dose leaving an interval of at least 4 hours.
entries.만 15세 이상은 1회 2포씩, 만 11세 이상~만 15세 미만은 1회: Those aged 15 years and over take 2 sachets at a time, those aged 11 years to under 15 years take 4/3 of a sachet at a time, those aged 8 years to under 11 years take 1 sachet at a time, those aged 5 years to under 8 years take 2/3 of a sachet at a time, those aged 3 years to under 5 years take 1/2 of a sachet at a time, and those aged 1 year to under 3 years take 2/5 of a sachet at a time, 3 times a day.
entries.만 15세 이상은 1회 3포 (15 ml)씩을, 만 11세 이상~만 15: Those aged 15 years and over take 3 sachets (15 mL) at a time, those aged 11 years and over but under 15 years take 2 sachets (10 mL) at a time, those aged 7 years and over but under 11 years take 1.5 sachets (7.5 mL) at a time, those aged 3 years and over but under 7 years take 1 sachet (5 mL) at a time, and those aged 2 years and over but under 3 years take 0.75 of a sachet (3.75 mL) at a time, 3 times a day, 30 minutes after meals. If necessary, it may be taken at bedtime. Allow an interval of at least 4 hours between doses.
entries.만 15세 이상은 1회 3포, 만 11세 이상~만 15세 미만 1회 2포: Those aged 15 years and older take 3 sachets at a time; those aged 11 years and older but under 15 years take 2 sachets at a time; those aged 7 years and older but under 11 years take 1½ sachets at a time; those aged 3 years and older but under 7 years take 1 sachet at a time; and those aged 2 years and older but under 3 years take 3/4 sachet at a time, 3 times a day, 30 minutes after meals and, if necessary, at bedtime, leaving an interval of 4 hours between doses.
entries.만 15세 이상은 1회 3포, 만 11세 이상~만 15세 미만은 1회 2: Those 15 years and older take 3 sachets at a time, those 11 years and older but under 15 years take 2 sachets at a time, those 7 years and older but under 11 years take 3/2 sachet at a time, those 3 years and older but under 7 years take 1 sachet at a time, and those 2 years and older but under 3 years take 3/4 sachet at a time, 3 times a day, avoiding an empty stomach. Leave an interval of at least 4 hours between doses.
entries.만 15세 이상은 1회 3포씩, 만 11세 이상~만 15세 미만은 1회: Those aged 15 years and over take 3 packets at a time, those aged 11 years and over but under 15 years take 2 packets at a time, those aged 7 years and over but under 11 years take 3/2 packets at a time, those aged 3 years and over but under 7 years take 1 packet at a time, and those aged 2 years and over but under 3 years take 3/4 of a packet at a time, 3 times a day, avoiding an empty stomach and leaving an interval of at least 4 hours.
entries.만 15세 이상은 1회 용량(15 mL)을 1일 4회 식후 30분 및 취: Those aged 15 years and over take one dose (15 mL) four times a day, 30 minutes after meals and at bedtime. However, when taking it 5 to 6 times a day, as a rule leave an interval of about 4 hours between doses.
entries.만 15세 이상은 2포, 만 11세 이상~만 15세 미만은 4/3포, 만: Those aged 15 years and over take 2 sachets, those aged 11 years to under 15 years take 4/3 of a sachet, those aged 7 years to under 11 years take 1 sachet, and those aged 3 years to under 7 years take 2/3 of a sachet. To prevent motion sickness, take one dose 30 minutes before boarding. If an additional dose is needed, take one dose leaving an interval of at least 4 hours, and limit the number of doses to 3 times a day.
entries.만 15세 이상의 성인은 1일 1~3회 적정량을 질환 부위에 직접 바르거: Adults aged 15 years and older should apply an appropriate amount directly to the diseased site or instill it into the rectum 1 to 3 times a day. For rectal application, attach the applicator to the tube and insert it into the rectum. Children under 15 years of age should apply an appropriate amount directly to the diseased site 1 to 3 times a day.
entries.만 15세 이상의 성인은 1회 1포(100 ml)를 1일 3회, 식후 3: Adults aged 15 years and older take 1 sachet (100 ml) at a time, 3 times a day, 30 minutes after meals. If necessary, take it at bedtime, and allow 4 hours between doses.
entries.만 15세 이상의 청소년 및 성인은 1회 1포씩, 1일 3회 식후 30분: Adolescents aged 15 years and older and adults take 1 packet at a time, 3 times a day, 30 minutes after meals. If necessary, it may be taken at bedtime. Keep the interval between doses at 4 hours.
entries.만 15세이상은 1회 12 ml(2포)씩, 만 11세이상～만 15세 미만: Those aged 15 years and over take 12 mL (2 sachets) at a time, those aged 11 years and over but under 15 years take 8 mL (1⅓ sachets) at a time, those aged 7 years and over but under 11 years take 6 mL (1 sachet) at a time, and those aged 3 years and over but under 7 years take 4 mL (⅔ of a sachet) at a time. To prevent motion sickness, take a single dose 30 minutes before boarding. If an additional dose is needed, take a single dose after allowing an interval of at least 4 hours, and limit the number of doses a day to 3 times.
entries.만 16세 이상은 1회 1정(10 mg)씩, 1일 2정(20 mg)까지: Those aged 16 years and older may take 1 tablet (10 mg) at a time, up to 2 tablets (20 mg) a day.
Those 19 years and older and adults take 1 tablet at a time, once a day.
Adults aged 19 years and over take 1 bottle at a time, once a day.
entries.만 24개월 이상~만 8세 미만은 1일 1회, 1회 1정, 만 8세 이상: Children aged 24 months and over but under 8 years take 1 tablet at a time, once a day, and those aged 8 years and over and adults take 1 tablet at a time, twice a day, letting it dissolve or chewing it.
entries.만 2세 미만의 소아, 이 약에 과민증 및 경험자, MAO억제제(항우울제: Children under 2 years of age, patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine or have experienced such hypersensitivity, people who are taking MAO inhibitors (antidepressants, antipsychotics, mood regulators, antiparkinsonian agents, etc.) or are within 2 weeks of having stopped them, patients with severe or uncontrolled high blood pressure, and patients with severe acute or chronic kidney disease/renal failure must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, people with an allergic constitution, people who have experienced allergic symptoms caused by a medicine (fever, rash, joint pain, asthma, itching, etc.), people with heart disease, glaucoma (eye pain, blurred vision, etc.) or difficulty urinating (passing urine), people with a weak body or a high fever, the elderly, patients with smoking, asthma, chronic bronchitis, emphysema, a cough accompanied by excessive phlegm, a cough that lasts more than 1 week or recurs, a chronic cough, or a cough accompanied by fever and rash or a persistent headache, people in whom symptoms of ischemic colitis (sudden abdominal pain, rectal bleeding, etc.) appear in connection with the pseudoephedrine component, and people who have experienced hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to Yellow No. 4, Yellow No. 5, Red No. 40 or Yellow No. 203 should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it 5 to 6 times, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Drowsiness may occur after taking it, so take care when driving or operating machinery.
entries.만 2세 미만의 소아, 이 약에 과민증 환자, 이 약 및 이 약의 구성성: Children under 2 years of age, patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, people who have had asthma after taking this medicine or its ingredients, other antipyretic analgesics, or cold medicines, infants under 3 months of age, and people who are taking MAO inhibitors (antidepressants, antipsychotics, mood regulators, antiparkinsonian agents, etc.) or who are within 2 weeks of stopping them must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are an infant or a child under 15 years of age who has, or is suspected of having, chickenpox or influenza; a person with a constitution prone to urticaria, contact dermatitis, bronchial asthma, allergic rhinitis, migraine, or food allergy; a person with liver disease, kidney disease, heart disease, thyroid disease, diabetes, high blood pressure, gastroduodenal ulcer, glaucoma, or difficulty urinating; an elderly person; a person in poor physical condition; a person with a high fever; a person whose gastrointestinal problems such as heartburn, stomach discomfort, or stomach pain persist or recur, or who has ulcers or bleeding problems; a pregnant woman or a woman who may be pregnant; a breastfeeding woman; or a person with a cough (smoking, asthma, chronic bronchitis, emphysema, a cough accompanied by excessive phlegm, a cough that persists or recurs for 1 week or more, a chronic cough, or a cough accompanied by fever, rash, or a persistent headache). Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Do not take it continuously for a long period. When administering it to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Drowsiness may occur after taking this medicine, so take care when driving or operating machinery.
entries.만 2세 이상 및 성인은 상처 및 주변 피부에 1일 수회 적용하여 가볍게: Those aged 2 years and older and adults apply it to the wound and surrounding skin several times a day and massage lightly.In adults, for hypertrophic scars, it may be applied thickly the day before and fixed with a bandage, and left on overnight.

Those 2 years and older and adults apply it to the wound and the surrounding skin several times a day and massage lightly. In adults, for hypertrophic scars, it may be applied thickly the day before and held in place with a bandage so that it stays on for one evening.
entries.만 2세 이상~12세 미만은 1일 1~3회의 범위내에서, 1회 1번 각: Those aged 2 years and over but under 12 years spray once into each nostril (inside the nose) at a time, within a range of 1 to 3 times a day. The interval between applications should be at least 8 hours.
entries.만 2세 이하의 젖먹이, 눈 또는 눈 주위, 점막(입안, 코안, 질),: Do not use this medicine on nursing infants aged 2 years or under, or on the eyes or the area around the eyes, mucous membranes (inside the mouth, inside the nose, the vagina), the genitals or the external genitalia, or on diseased areas with eczema, dampness, severe erosion, cracking or wounds. Before using this medicine, people with an allergic constitution, those who have experienced allergic symptoms (rash and congested reddened skin, itching, dermatitis caused by lacquer, etc.), patients whose diseased area is on the face or is extensive or festering, and young children should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine externally only; do not take it internally or inhale it. Take care that it does not get into the eyes, and if it does, rinse it out immediately with water. Clean the diseased area and the area around it before use. Shake well before use. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.
entries.만 2세 이하의 젖먹이, 눈 또는 눈주위, 점막(입안, 코안, 질 등),: Do not use it on infants aged 2 years or under, or on the eyes or the area around the eyes, mucous membranes (inside the mouth, inside the nose, the vagina, etc.), the genitals, the external genitalia, or diseased areas with severe eczema, dampness, rawness, cracking or wounds. Before using this medicine, people who have experienced allergic symptoms (rash and reddening from congestion, itching, dermatitis caused by lacquer, etc.), people with an allergic constitution, people whose diseased area is on the face or is extensive, people whose diseased area is festering, people for whom the distinction between eczema and athlete's foot or jock itch (groin ringworm (tinea corporis)) is unclear, and young children should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine for external use only and do not take it by mouth. Take care that it does not get into the eyes; if it does, wash immediately with water and be examined by an eye specialist. Clean the diseased area and its surroundings before use. Shake well before use. Spray from a distance of 5 cm from the diseased area. Do not spray continuously on the same area for more than 3 seconds. If there is no improvement in symptoms after using it for about 2 weeks, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. When using it on a child, use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully.
entries.만 2세~6세 소아는 1회 5 mL씩, 만 6세~12세 소아는 1회 10: Children aged 2 to 6 years take 5 mL at a time and children aged 6 to 12 years take 10 mL at a time, every 4 to 6 hours. Do not take 4 or more doses in 24 hours.
entries.만 3∼12세는 1회 5 mL씩, 만 12세 이상 및 성인은 1회 10: Children aged 3 to 12 years take 5 mL at a time, and those aged 12 years and over and adults take 10 mL at a time, 3 times a day. The dose may be increased or decreased appropriately according to age and symptoms.
entries.만 3개월 미만 젖먹이 및 만 1세 미만 젖먹이, 갈락토오스 불내성, L: Infants under 3 months of age and infants under 1 year of age, and patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption must not take this medicine.Before taking this medicine, infants under 1 year of age in unavoidable cases and pregnant women or women who may be pregnant should consult a doctor or pharmacist.Strictly observe the specified dosage and administration.When administering to children, do so under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.If there is no improvement in symptoms after about 2 weeks of administration, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.만 3개월 미만~1세 미만의 젖먹이는 이 약을 복용하지 마십시오.이 약을: Infants from under 3 months to under 1 year of age must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant, patients with high blood pressure, elderly people, patients with heart disorder or kidney disorder, patients with edema (swelling), patients with diarrhea accompanied by fever, elderly patients, patients with bloody stools or with continuing mucous stools, and people on a sodium-restricted diet should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 1 month, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.만 3개월 미만의 영아, 이 약에 과민증 환자 및 경험자는 이 약을 복용: Infants under 3 months of age and patients who have or have had hypersensitivity to this medicine must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if the user has an allergic constitution, has experienced an allergic reaction (fever, rash, joint pain, asthma, itching), has heart disease, glaucoma (eye pain, dim vision) or difficulty urinating, is physically weak or has a high fever, is a pregnant woman or a woman who may be pregnant, is elderly, smokes, has asthma, chronic bronchitis or emphysema, has a cough accompanied by excessive phlegm, a cough that lasts for 1 week or more or recurs, a chronic cough, or a cough accompanied by fever, rash or persistent headache, has hypersensitivity to Yellow No. 5 or Sunset Yellow FCF or has experienced an allergic reaction to them, or is a child under 2 years of age. If the symptoms do not improve after 5 to 6 doses, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed directions and amounts. Because drowsiness may appear after taking it, take care when driving or operating machinery.
entries.만 3개월 미만의 영아는 이 약을 복용하지 마십시오.이 약을 복용하기 전: Infants under 3 months of age must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist in the case of children under 2 years of age; an allergic constitution; a history of allergic reactions (fever, rash, joint pain, asthma, itching, etc.); liver disease, kidney disease, heart disease, thyroid disease, diabetes, high blood pressure, heart disease, kidney disease, edema, glaucoma (eye pain, blurred vision, etc.), difficulty urinating, thyroid disease, or diabetes; being physically weak or having a high fever; being pregnant, possibly pregnant, or breastfeeding; being elderly; or smoking, asthma, chronic bronchitis, emphysema, a cough with excessive phlegm, a cough lasting 1 week or longer or recurring, a chronic cough, or a cough accompanied by fever and rash or a persistent headache. Follow the specified dosage and administration carefully. When it is given to children, give it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Drowsiness may occur after taking it, so take care when driving or operating machinery. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it 5 to 6 times, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.만 3개월 미만의 젖먹이는 이 약을 복용하지 마십시오.이 약을 복용하기: Infants under 3 months of age must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if the user is an infant under 1 year of age or a patient with renal impairment. Follow the prescribed directions and amounts. If the symptoms do not improve after about 2 weeks of use, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

Nursing infants under 3 months of age must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if the user is a nursing infant under 1 year of age or if you are pregnant or may be pregnant. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 2 weeks, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

Infants under 3 months of age must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, infants under 1 year of age and pregnant women or women who may be pregnant should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. If there is no improvement in symptoms after about 2 weeks of taking it, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

Nursing infants under 3 months of age must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, nursing infants aged 3 months and over but under 1 year in unavoidable cases, and pregnant women or women who may be pregnant, should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 2 weeks, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.

Infants under 3 months of age must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, women who are pregnant or may be pregnant and people who have experienced hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to caramel should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 2 weeks, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.만 3개월 미만의 젖먹이에게 투여하지 마십시오.만 1세 미만의 젖먹이는: Do not give this medicine to infants under 3 months of age. For infants under 1 year of age, seeing a doctor should come first, and it is preferable not to give this medicine except when unavoidable. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving this medicine to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 2 weeks, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.만 3세 미만의 영ㆍ유아, 수유부는 이 약을 복용하지 마십시오.이 약을: Infants and young children under 3 years of age and breastfeeding women should not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women, people who have experienced allergic symptoms to medicines (rash, congested and reddened skin, itching, etc.), and patients with glaucoma (eye pain, blurred vision, etc.), urinary difficulty, or a respiratory disease such as emphysema or chronic bronchitis should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration exactly. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Drowsiness may occur after taking it, so be careful when driving or operating machinery.
entries.만 6세 이하의 어린이가 과량 복용시 철분 중독성 사망을 일으킬 수 있으: An overdose in children aged 6 years or younger may cause fatal iron poisoning, so keep this medicine out of the reach of children.
entries.만 7~12세 소아는 1회 권장용량을 4~6시간마다 필요시 물 없이 혀에: Children aged 7 to 12 years take the recommended single dose directly on the tongue without water, every 4 to 6 hours as needed. Take this medicine at the lowest effective dose for the shortest possible period, and do not take it more than 5 times a day (75 mg/kg). If the body weight is known, it is more appropriate to take a dose based on body weight (10 to 15 mg/kg). For the doses by age group, refer to the approved product information.
entries.만 7세 미만의 어린이 및 만 2세 미만의 영아, 이 약에 과민증 환자: Children under 7 years of age, infants under 2 years of age, and patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine or those who have experienced it must not use this medicine.Before using this medicine, those with an allergic constitution, those who have experienced allergic symptoms caused by medicines including nasal sprays for rhinitis, pregnant women and women who may be pregnant, and patients with hypersensitivity to propylene glycol or those who have experienced it should consult a doctor or pharmacist.Before using this medicine, patients with high blood pressure, heart disease, diabetes, thyroid disease, or glaucoma should consult a doctor or pharmacist.Before using this medicine, people who smoke or who have asthma, chronic bronchitis, emphysema, a cough accompanied by excessive phlegm, a cough persisting or recurring for 1 week or more, a chronic cough, or a cough accompanied by fever and rash or persistent headache should consult a doctor or pharmacist.Use this medicine only as a nasal spray for rhinitis, that is, a medicine sprayed inside the nose.Do not use it in the eyes or ears.To prevent contamination, do not share it with others.If there is no improvement after 3 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.Drowsiness may occur during use.Be careful when driving a car or operating machinery.Children should use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.Strictly observe the specified dosage and administration.Excessive use may instead cause nasal congestion.Do not use it continuously for more than 7 days.

Children under 7 years of age and infants under 2 years of age, and patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine or a history of it, must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, people with an allergic constitution, people who have experienced allergic symptoms from medicines including nasal sprays for rhinitis, pregnant women, women who may be pregnant, patients with hypersensitivity to propylene glycol or a history of it, and patients with high blood pressure, heart disease, diabetes, thyroid disease, or glaucoma should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Before using this medicine, people with smoking, asthma, chronic bronchitis, emphysema, a cough with excessive phlegm, a cough lasting 1 week or longer or recurring, a chronic cough, or a cough accompanied by fever and rash or a persistent headache should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine only as a nasal spray for rhinitis, that is, a medicine sprayed inside the nose. Do not use it in the eyes or ears. Do not share it with others, in order to prevent contamination. Drowsiness may occur while using it. Be careful when driving a car or operating machinery. If it does not improve after 3 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not use it continuously for more than 7 days. Children should use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Follow the specified dosage and administration carefully. Excessive use may instead cause nasal congestion.
entries.만 7세 이상 및 성인에게 1회 1번씩, 1일 3회 양쪽 코 안에 뿌리십: For those aged 7 years and over and adults, spray once into both nostrils at a time, 3 times a day. Leave an interval of at least 3 hours between each use.
entries.만 7세 이상 및 성인은 1일 2회, 1회 1번씩 양쪽 비강(코안)에 분: Those aged 7 years and over and adults spray it once into each nostril (inside the nose) at a time, twice a day. Leave an interval of at least 8 hours between each use.
entries.만 7세 이상 및 성인은 1회 1~2번씩, 1일 1~2회로 각 코 안에: Those aged 7 years and older and adults spray 1 to 2 times into each nostril per dose, 1 to 2 times a day. Spray at intervals of 10 to 12 hours, and do not exceed 2 times in 24 hours.
entries.만 7세 이상 및 성인은 1회 1번씩, 1일 2회 양쪽 코 안에 뿌리십시: Those aged 7 years and over and adults spray once at a time into both nostrils, twice a day. Use it at intervals of 10 to 12 hours. Do not exceed 2 doses in 24 hours.
entries.만 7세 이상 및 성인은 1회 1번씩, 1일 2회로 양쪽 코 안에 뿌리십: Those aged 7 years and over and adults spray once at a time into both nostrils, twice a day. Spray at intervals of 10 to 12 hours each time, and do not exceed 2 times in 24 hours.
entries.만 7세 이상 및 성인은 1회 2번씩 코 안에 뿌리십시오.3시간 이상의: Those aged 7 years and older and adults spray 2 times into the nose per use.Spray with an interval of at least 3 hours between doses, and do not exceed 6 times a day.
entries.만 7세 이하의 소아는 이 약을 복용하지 마십시오.이 약을 복용하기 전에: Children aged 7 years or younger must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients with high blood pressure, elderly people, patients with heart or kidney impairment, and people with swelling should consult a doctor or pharmacist. entries.만 7세 이하의 어린이, 갈락토오스 불내성, Lapp 유당(젖당)분해효소: Children 7 years of age and under, and patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase (milk sugar enzyme) deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption, must not take this medicine. If there is no improvement in symptoms even after several doses, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

entries.발진을 동반한 과민반응, 과도한 자극, 피부의 두드러기, 발적, 발진,: If a hypersensitivity reaction accompanied by rash, excessive irritation, urticaria of the skin, redness, rash, erythema, itching, an irritating sensation, local contact dermatitis, peeling of the skin, scabbing of the wound, abnormal pigmentation, stinging pain or a burning sensation occur, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.방귀, 통증, 복통(배아픔), 경련 또는 배에 그득한 느낌과 같은 복부(: If abdominal (belly) discomfort such as flatulence, pain, abdominal pain (stomach ache), cramps, or a feeling of fullness in the abdomen, rarely vomiting, occasionally nausea, borborygmus (the sound of gas in the intestines) or anal itching, diarrhea, an increased number of bowel movements, loss of appetite, itching, elevated LDH, decreased hemoglobin, eosinophilia, or malaise occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.배변 습관에 갑작스러운 변화, 묽은 변, 설사가 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉: If a sudden change in bowel habits, loose stools or diarrhea occurs, stop taking the medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Belching, cramping abdominal discomfort and, occasionally, rumbling in the abdomen, a feeling of abdominal fullness, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, nausea and vomiting may occur.
entries.배변 습관에 갑작스런 변화가 있거나 1주 정도 복용하여도 변비의 개선이: If there is a sudden change in bowel habits, or if there is no improvement in constipation after taking it for about 1 week, stop taking it and consult a pharmacist or doctor.
Constipation and the like may occur.
entries.변비 또는 설사 등이 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고 의사 또는 약사: If constipation or diarrhea appears, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

entries.변비 또는 설사의 증상이 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고 의사 또는: If symptoms of constipation or diarrhea appear, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

entries.보통 1일 1회 또는 감염의 심한 정도에 따라 1일 2회 바를 수 있습니: Usually it may be applied once a day, or twice a day depending on the severity of the infection. Continue applying it for several days even after the symptoms have disappeared.

entries.보통 성인(만 15세 이상)은 1회 1포(1회 용량)씩, 만 11세 이상: Ordinarily, adults (aged 15 years and older) take 1 sachet (a single dose) at a time; those aged 11 years and older but under 15 years take 2/3 sachet (2/3 of the adult single dose) at a time; and those aged 7 years and older but under 11 years take 1/2 sachet (1/2 of the adult single dose) at a time, 3 times a day, 30 minutes after meals.
Adults usually take 4 tablets per dose, 3 times a day before a meal or between meals.
entries.복부팽만감, 구토, 변비, 두드러기, 발진, 가려움 및 혈관 부종 등이: If abdominal distension, vomiting, constipation, urticaria, rash, itching, and angioedema occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.복통, 구토, 설사, 가려움, 두드러기, 홍반성 발진, 얼굴 부기와 같은: Abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhea, allergic skin adverse reactions such as itching, urticaria, erythematous rash, and facial swelling, and very rarely anaphylaxis may occur.
entries.복통, 발열, 추위, 질 분비물에서의 악취, 본인이나 성관계 대상이 작열: If abdominal pain, fever, chills, a foul odor in the vaginal discharge, a burning sensation, itching, rash or other irritation of the vagina or penis in yourself or your sexual partner, difficulty urinating or pain on urination, or pregnancy occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.본인 또는 상대방에 발진 또는 자극이 나타나는 경우 사용을 즉각 중지하고: If a rash or irritation appears in the user or in the partner, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.부기, 자극감, 화농(곪음), 알레르기 증상(발진, 충혈되어 붉어짐, 가: If swelling, an irritating sensation, suppuration (festering), allergic symptoms (rash, congested and reddened skin, itching, etc.) or bleeding occur, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.부정맥용제(토카이니드 등)와 함께 사용 시 의사 또는 약사와 상의하십시오: Consult a doctor or pharmacist when using it together with an antiarrhythmic medicine (tocainide, etc.).
entries.부종(부기), 숨가쁨, 피로, 탈수증상, 심부전 등이 나타나는 경우 복용: If edema (swelling), shortness of breath, fatigue, symptoms of dehydration, heart failure or the like occurs, stop taking the medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Gastrointestinal adverse reactions, allergic reactions, angioedema, difficulty breathing, rash, erythematous rash, urticaria, pruritus (itching), hyperkalemia, hypokalemia, headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, nausea, indigestion, abdominal distension, rumbling in the abdomen (the sound of gas in the bowel), flatulence (abdominal distension), anal discomfort and peripheral edema (swelling) may occur.
entries.부종(부기), 자극감, 알레르기 증상(발진, 충혈되어 붉어짐, 가려움 등: If edema (swelling), a feeling of irritation, allergic symptoms (rash, congestion causing reddening, itching, etc.), or bleeding occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.불면, 어지러움, 두통, 떨림, 구역, 구토, 소화불량, 상복부 통증,: If insomnia, dizziness, headache, tremor, nausea, vomiting, indigestion, upper abdominal pain, diarrhea, constipation, abdominal distension, hiccups, gastritis, dry mouth, stomatitis, esophagitis, oral discomfort, difficulty swallowing, belching, excessive salivation, pharyngitis, cough, sore throat, difficulty breathing, palpitations, atrial arrhythmia, tachycardia (rapid pulse), hypersensitivity, angioneurotic edema, urticaria, ulcerative stomatitis, anaphylaxis, asthenia, fatigue, malaise, or influenza-like illness occurs, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.Occasionally, mild throat irritation, increased salivation, hiccups, indigestion, or heartburn may occur at the beginning of treatment.
entries.불안, 어지러움, 급성전신발진고름물집증, 홍반, 다수의 작은 농포, 불면: If anxiety, dizziness, acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis, erythema, numerous small pustules, or insomnia occurs, if a sore throat lasts 2 days or longer, or if headache, fever, rash, nausea, vomiting, or ischemic colitis (sudden abdominal pain, rectal bleeding, etc.) occurs, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. If symptoms of posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome and reversible cerebral vasoconstriction syndrome (sudden severe headache, thunderclap headache, nausea, vomiting, confusion, seizures, visual disturbances, etc.) occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Excitement (especially in children) and drowsiness may occur.
entries.붉어짐, 부종(부기), 자극각, 화농(곪음), 발진, 충혈되어 붉어짐,: If redness, swelling, a feeling of irritation, suppuration, rash, redness with congestion, itching or bleeding appears, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.붉은 반점, 설사, 부전수축 및 심장박동정지, 중추신경계 기능저하 등이: If red spots, diarrhea, asystole and cardiac arrest, or depression of central nervous system function appears, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.붉은 반점, 설사, 부전수축(심장박동정지), 중추신경계 기능저하 등이 나: If red spots, diarrhea, incomplete contraction (cardiac arrest), or central nervous system depression occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
If red spots, diarrhea, asystole (cardiac arrest) or depression of central nervous system function appears, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.붉은 반점, 설사, 부전수축(심장박동정지), 중추신경계 기능저하, 구역,: If red spots, diarrhea, asystole (stopping of the heartbeat), decreased central nervous system function, gastrointestinal symptoms such as nausea and vomiting, hypernatremia, congestive heart failure, or edema (swelling) occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.붉은 반점, 설사, 부전수축(심장박동정지), 중추신경계 기능저하가 나타나: If red spots, diarrhea, asystole (cessation of the heartbeat), or reduced central nervous system function occurs, or if there is no improvement in symptoms after about 1 month of taking it, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.붉은 반점, 설사, 부전수축, 중추신경계 기능저하 등이 나타나는 경우 이: If red spots, diarrhea, asystole or depression of central nervous system function appears, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.붉은반점, 설사, 심장박동정지, 중추신경계 기능저하 등이 나타나는 경우: If red patches, diarrhea, cardiac arrest or depressed central nervous system function occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.붉은반점, 설사, 심장박동정지, 중추신경계기능저하, 복부불쾌감, 변비,: If red spots, diarrhea, cardiac arrest, depressed central nervous system function, abdominal discomfort, constipation, loss of appetite, rash or the like occurs, stop taking the medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.비감수성균의 과도한 증식, 홍반, 가려움, 중복감염, 가려움, 발적, 종: If excessive growth of non-susceptible bacteria, erythema, itching, superinfection, itching, redness, swelling, papules, small blisters, rash or contact dermatitis appears, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.비누 등으로 세안 후 적당량을 1일 수회 환부(질환 부위)에 도포하여 사: After washing the face with soap or the like, apply an appropriate amount to the affected area (the diseased site) several times per 1 day.
After washing the face with soap or a similar cleanser, apply an appropriate amount to the affected area (diseased site) several times in 1 day.
entries.비누나 다른 음이온성 물질, 요오드화 칼륨, 산화성 상처 세척제와 함께: Do not use together with soap or other anionic substances, potassium iodide, or oxidizing wound cleansers.

entries.비타민 A를 1일 5,000 IU 이상 복용 시 선천성 기형을 일으킬 수: Taking 5,000 IU or more of vitamin A a day may cause congenital malformations. Women within 3 months of pregnancy or women who may be pregnant must not take it.

Taking 5,000 IU or more of vitamin A a day may cause congenital malformations. Women within 3 months of pregnancy or who may be pregnant must not take it. An overdose in children aged 6 years or younger may cause death from iron poisoning, so keep it out of the reach of children.
entries.비타민 C와 같은 환원제는 함께 복용하지 마십시오.비타민 C를 복용하려면: Do not take reducing agents such as vitamin C together with this medicine. If you need to take vitamin C, take it separately with an interval of about 4 hours from this medicine.
entries.사람 태반을 원재료로 사용하여 제조한 것이므로 그 유익성이 위험성을 웃도: Since it is manufactured using human placenta as a raw material, take it only when its benefits outweigh its risks.
entries.사용 전 잘 흔들어 섞은 후 1일 1~3회 적당량을 환부(질환 부위)에: Shake well to mix before use, then apply an appropriate amount to the affected area (the diseased site) 1 to 3 times a day, increasing or decreasing the amount appropriately according to symptoms.

Shake well to mix before use, then apply an appropriate amount to the affected area (the diseased site) 1 to 3 times a day, increasing or decreasing the amount as appropriate according to symptoms. Limit the treatment period with this medicine to 7 days or less.
entries.사용 전 잘 흔들어 섞은 후 1일 1~3회 적당량을 환부(질환부위)에 바: Shake well to mix before use, apply an appropriate amount to the affected area (the diseased site) 1 to 3 times a day, and increase or decrease the amount appropriately according to the symptoms.
Do not drink alcohol while using this medicine.
entries.상처 부위를 깨끗이 한 후 한 겹을 도포하며, 필요 시에는 다른 드레싱으: After cleaning the wound area, apply a single layer, and cover it with another dressing if necessary. Changing the dressing every day is appropriate, but the frequency of use is decided according to the clinical situation.
entries.상처나 감염된 부위에 1일 수회 엷게 바른후 피부를 가볍게 문질러 줍니다: Apply a thin layer to the wounded or infected area several times a day and then rub the skin gently.
entries.생후 1개월 미만의 소아는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.이 약을 사용하기: Do not use this medicine on children under 1 month of age. Before using this medicine, patients with an allergic constitution, patients hypersensitive to medicines or cosmetics, patients with severe wetness (dampness) or inflammation, and infants and young children under 6 years of age should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use this medicine externally only; do not use it internally. Be careful that it does not get into the eyes, and if it does, rinse it out immediately with water.

For children weighing 30 kg or less, do not exceed a maximum of 25 mL (300 mg) a day. For the recommended single dose by age group, refer to the approved product information.

entries.설사 시 식사를 계속하는 경우 생음식, 과일, 야채, 매운 음식, 냉동된: If you continue to eat while you have diarrhea, do not eat raw food, fruit, vegetables, spicy food, or frozen food or drinks.
entries.설사, 구역, 구토, 배 아픔, 변비, 가슴앓이, 위부불쾌감, 가려움,: If diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, stomach ache, constipation, heartburn, stomach discomfort, itching, rash, general malaise, dizziness, calcification of gallstones, increases in liver enzyme values (ALT, ALP, AST, γ-GT), a decrease in white blood cells, or interstitial pneumonia accompanied by fever, coughing, difficulty breathing and abnormal chest X-ray findings occurs, stop taking the medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

entries.성교 10분~1시간 전에 질 깊숙이 좌약 1개를 삽입하고, 이 약 삽입: Insert 1 suppository deep into the vagina 10 minutes to 1 hour before sexual intercourse; if intercourse does not occur within 1 hour after inserting this medicine, or if intercourse is repeated, insert another one.

entries.이 약 또는 아스피린 등 비스테로이드성 소염(항염)진통제에 과민증 환자,: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine or to non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics such as aspirin; patients with peptic ulcer, severe blood abnormalities, severe liver disorder, severe cardiac insufficiency, severe kidney disorder, or severe high blood pressure; patients who have had asthma, rhinitis (nasal inflammation), nasal polyps, urticaria, or allergic reactions caused by aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics (including COX-2 inhibitors); use for the treatment of pain occurring before or after coronary artery (heart artery) bypass surgery; and patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption must not take this medicine. entries.이 약 또는 히드록시진 또는 피페라진 유도체에 과민증 환자 또는 경험자,: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine or to hydroxyzine or piperazine derivatives or those who have experienced it, patients with renal failure, pregnant women and women who may be pregnant, breastfeeding women, infants under 2 years of age, and patients with fructose intolerance should not take this medicine. entries.이 약 및 단백질계 약물 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.이 약: Patients hypersensitive to this medicine or to protein-based medicines must not use this medicine. entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 갑상선기능 이상 환자, 6세 미만의 소아, 방사성: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, patients with thyroid dysfunction, children under 6 years of age, and those during radioactive iodine treatment and before and after such treatment must not use this medicine. Keep it from touching jewelry (especially items containing silver). When it is used in children, have them use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully.

entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 신생아 및 6개월 미만의 영아, 방사성요오드치료: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, newborns and infants under 6 months of age, patients before or after radioactive iodine treatment, patients with thyroid dysfunction such as nodular goiter, endemic goiter, or Hashimoto's thyroiditis, patients with renal failure, and patients with dermatitis herpetiformis must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, seriously ill patients such as burn patients, people who have had thyroid disease, and people who have had renal failure should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not use it in the eyes or take it internally. Take care not to let the undiluted solution get into the eyes. If it gets into the eyes, rinse immediately with clean water. Wash and disinfect the affected area thoroughly. When using it on severe wounds, use distilled water for injection or sterile purified water as the diluent. Do not use tap water or purified water. If this medicine gets on clothing or the like, washing it immediately makes it come out easily with water. In the case of synthetic fibers, it can be removed with ammonia water or sodium thiosulfate. Wash off soaps thoroughly before using this medicine. When it is used just before delivery, wash the newborn's eyes and bathe the baby as soon as possible after delivery so that the medicine does not remain on the baby. Provide plenty of fluids to patients with extensive burns. In the case of ulcers caused by burns, use it only on ulcers resulting from secondary damage after a burn. Do not use it on newly occurring burns. Leave an interval of 1 to 2 weeks between the use of this medicine and flash irradiation. If an infection such as peritonitis or osteomyelitis occurs, wash with physiological saline before using this medicine. If the iodine of this medicine is absorbed through healthy or damaged skin, it interferes with thyroid function tests.

entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 알츠하이머병, 치질, 체액 저류(부기), 임신 중: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine and patients with Alzheimer's disease, hemorrhoids, fluid retention (swelling), toxemia of pregnancy, diarrhea, or undiagnosed gastrointestinal bleeding must not take this medicine. Even if you forget to use this medicine, do not make up the missed dose; simply apply the next dose as usual. This medicine is for external use only; do not use it on areas other than the scalp. Do not use occlusive dressing. Use of this medicine may cause burning and irritation of the eyes, so be careful that it does not get into the eyes, and if it comes into contact with sensitive areas such as the eyes, broken skin, or mucous membranes, rinse them immediately with clean water. Wash your hands thoroughly after using this medicine. Use hair styling products after this medicine has dried, and when using it in the evening, apply it 2 to 4 hours before bedtime so that it can dry. Because circulation of air over the scalp may reduce the effect of this medicine, do not use a hair dryer to speed up its drying. If there is no improvement in symptoms after 4 months or more of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

When a patient who has taken this medicine undergoes electrocautery during proctoscopy or colonoscopy, the presence of a high concentration of hydrogen gas in the intestine creates a risk of explosion from an electrical flame, so perform the examination after completely cleansing the bowel with a non-fermentable solution.

This medicine must not be taken by patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, by patients who have or have had gastrointestinal ulcer or gastrointestinal bleeding, by patients with severe blood abnormality, severe liver impairment, severe renal impairment, severe cardiac insufficiency or severe high blood pressure, by patients who have or have had bronchial asthma, by patients who have or have had hypersensitivity such as asthma, urticaria or an allergic reaction to aspirin or another non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesic (including COX-2 inhibitors), by patients with pain occurring before or after coronary artery bypass surgery, by pregnant women in the last 3 months of pregnancy, by patients taking high-dose methotrexate as anticancer therapy, or by patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if the user has or has had blood abnormality, has a bleeding tendency, has or has had cirrhosis or liver impairment, has or has had renal impairment, has cardiac insufficiency or heart disease, high blood pressure, a history of hypersensitivity, systemic lupus erythematosus or mixed connective tissue disease, ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease, is elderly or a child, is a pregnant woman or a breast-feeding woman, or is taking low-dose aspirin to prevent myocardial infarction or stroke. Without the direction of a doctor or pharmacist, do not take it for pain for 10 days or more (adults) or 5 days or more (children), and do not take it for fever for 3 days or more.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, patients with gastrointestinal ulcer or gastrointestinal bleeding or a history of it, patients with severe blood disorders, severe liver disorder, severe kidney disorder, severe cardiac insufficiency, severe high blood pressure or bronchial asthma or a history of it, patients with hypersensitivity such as asthma, urticaria or allergic reactions to aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics (including COX-2 inhibitors) or a history of it, patients with pain occurring before or after coronary artery bypass graft surgery (CABG), pregnant women in the last 3 months of pregnancy, and patients receiving high-dose methotrexate as anticancer therapy must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients with blood disorders or a history of them, patients with a tendency to bleed, patients with liver cirrhosis, liver disorder or a history of it, patients with kidney disorder or a history of it, patients with cardiac insufficiency or heart disease, high blood pressure, systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and mixed connective tissue disease (MCTD), ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease, elderly people and children, pregnant women, and breastfeeding women should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 위장관궤양, 위장관출혈, 심한 혈액이상, 심한 간: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, gastrointestinal ulcer, gastrointestinal bleeding, severe blood abnormalities, severe hepatic impairment, severe renal impairment, severe cardiac insufficiency, severe high blood pressure, or bronchial asthma, patients who have experienced asthma, urticaria, or allergic reactions caused by aspirin or other anti-inflammatory analgesics, patients with pain occurring before or after coronary artery bypass surgery, pregnant women in the last 3 months of pregnancy, breastfeeding women, patients receiving high-dose methotrexate as cancer chemotherapy, and patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption should not take this medicine. Do not take more than the recommended dose. Before taking this medicine, patients with blood abnormalities or a bleeding tendency, patients with liver cirrhosis, hepatic impairment, renal impairment, cardiac insufficiency, heart disease, high blood pressure, systemic lupus erythematosus, mixed connective tissue disease, ulcerative colitis, or Crohn's disease, elderly people, children under 2 years of age, pregnant women, and patients with chickenpox should consult a doctor or pharmacist. When taking it for a cold, take it for no more than 5 days as a rule, and without the direction of a doctor or pharmacist do not take it for pain for 10 days or more (adults) or 5 days or more (children), and do not take it for fever for 3 days or more.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 이 약 및 이 약의 구성성분, 다른 해열진통제,: Patients hypersensitive to this medicine, people who have experienced asthma when taking this medicine or its ingredients, other antipyretic analgesics, or cold remedies, infants and young children under 3 months of age and under 2 years of age, and women from week 30 of pregnancy onward must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, infants (newborns) and children under 15 years of age who are infected with or suspected of having chickenpox or influenza, people with an allergic constitution, people who have experienced allergic symptoms caused by medicines (e.g. fever, rash, joint pain, asthma, itching, etc.), people with liver disease, kidney disease, thyroid disease, diabetes, or high blood pressure, people who are physically weak or who have a high fever, elderly people, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant, breastfeeding women, people with persistent or recurring gastrointestinal problems such as heartburn, stomach discomfort, or stomach pain or with ulcers or bleeding problems, and people who have lost a lot of fluid through vomiting and diarrhea or who are not taking in fluids should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If there is no improvement in symptoms after 5 to 6 doses, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When administering it to children, do so under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.

Patients hypersensitive to this medicine, those who have experienced asthma when taking this medicine or its ingredients, other antipyretic analgesics or cold medicines, infants (nursing infants, newborns) under 3 months of age, people who are taking MAO inhibitors (antidepressants, antipsychotics, mood regulators, antiparkinson drugs, etc.) or are within 2 weeks of stopping them, and patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, the following should consult a doctor or pharmacist: infants (nursing infants, newborns) and children under 15 years of age who are infected with or suspected of having chickenpox or influenza; infants and young children aged 3 months and over but under 2 years; people with an allergic constitution or who have experienced allergic symptoms caused by a medicine (e.g. fever, rash, joint pain, asthma, itching, etc.); people with liver disease, kidney disease, heart disease, thyroid disease, diabetes, high blood pressure, edema (swelling) or gastroduodenal ulcer; the elderly; people with a weak body or a high fever; people with persistent or recurrent stomach problems such as heartburn, stomach discomfort or stomach pain, or with ulcers or bleeding problems; and pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it 5 to 6 times, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 이 약에 과민증 환자, 콩 또는 땅콩에 과민증 환: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine, patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine, patients who are hypersensitive to soybeans or peanuts, people who have experienced an allergic reaction to soybean oil, and patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients with disorders of fat metabolism such as hyperlipoproteinemia, diabetic hyperlipidemia or pancreatitis (inflammation of the pancreas), patients to whom lipid emulsions must be given with caution, and patients for whom fat overload poses a particular risk should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. It turns the urine yellow, which may affect clinical test values. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 1 month, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 이 약의 구성성분 또는 다른 해열진통제, 감기약: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine, people who have experienced asthma when taking the ingredients of this medicine or other antipyretic analgesics or cold remedies, and infants (newborns) under 3 months of age must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if the user is an infant or young child under 2 years of age; if the user is an infant (nursing infant, newborn) or a child under 15 years of age who has or is suspected of having chickenpox or influenza; if the user is a child under 2 years of age; if you have an allergic constitution or have experienced allergic reactions (fever, rash, joint pain, asthma, itching, etc.); if you have liver disease, kidney disease, heart disease, thyroid disease, diabetes, high blood pressure, gastroduodenal ulcer, glaucoma (eye pain, blurred vision, etc.), or difficulty urinating; if you are elderly, frail, or have a high fever; if you have persistent or recurring stomach problems such as heartburn, stomach discomfort, or stomach pain, or ulcer or bleeding problems; if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding; or if you smoke or have asthma, chronic bronchitis, emphysema, a cough accompanied by excessive phlegm, a cough that lasts or recurs for 1 week or more, a chronic cough, or a cough accompanied by fever and rash or a persistent headache. If the symptoms do not improve after taking 5 to 6 doses, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Drowsiness may occur after taking it, so be careful when driving or operating machinery.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, people who have experienced asthma after taking the ingredients of this medicine or other antipyretic analgesics or cold medicines, and infants under 3 months of age must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, infants (newborns) and children under 15 years of age who have, or are suspected of having, chickenpox or influenza, children under 2 years of age, people with an allergic constitution, people who have experienced allergic reactions (fever, rash, joint pain, asthma, itching, etc.), people with liver disease, kidney disease, heart disease, thyroid disease, diabetes, or high blood pressure, people in poor physical condition or with a high fever, the elderly, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women, and people whose gastrointestinal problems such as heartburn, stomach discomfort, or stomach pain persist or recur or who have ulcers or bleeding problems should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If symptoms do not improve after taking it 5 to 6 times, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When administering it to children, use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, those who have experienced asthma when taking the components of this medicine or other antipyretic analgesics or cold remedies, and infants under 3 months of age must not take this medicine.Before taking this medicine, infants infected with or suspected of having chickenpox or influenza and children under 15 years of age, children under 2 years of age, those with an allergic constitution, those who have experienced allergic reactions (fever, rash, joint pain, asthma, itching, etc.), people with liver disease, kidney disease, heart disease, thyroid disease, diabetes, or high blood pressure, physically weak people or people with a high fever, elderly people, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women, and people with persistent or recurring gastrointestinal problems such as heartburn, gastric discomfort, or stomach pain or with ulcer or bleeding problems should consult a doctor or pharmacist.If symptoms do not improve after taking it 5 to 6 times, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.Strictly observe the specified dosage and administration.When administering to children, use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 임부 또는 임신하고 있을 가능성이 있는 여성 및: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, women who are pregnant or may be pregnant and breastfeeding women, children, and patients with severe biliary obstruction, fulminant hepatitis, inflammation of the large and small intestine such as Crohn's disease, radiolucent calcified gallstones, a non-functioning gallbladder, acute cholecystitis (inflammation of the gallbladder), kidney disease, or peptic ulcer (acute gastric or duodenal ulcer) must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients with severe pancreatic disease or gallstone disease should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the specified dosage and administration carefully.

Patients hypersensitive to this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women, and children must not use this medicine. Do not use occlusive dressing or wrapping unless instructed by a doctor. In cases of candidiasis, do not use acidic soap. Apply this medicine for external use only. Do not use it on the cornea or conjunctiva as an ophthalmic preparation; if it accidentally gets into the eyes it may irritate them and, rarely, may worsen a latent fungal (mold) infection, so rinse them thoroughly with plenty of water. Do not use it on the nails, the scalp, around the mouth, or the vaginal area. If symptoms do not improve even after the treatment period, consult a doctor or pharmacist.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women, and infants and young children must not use this medicine. Do not use it on the eyes or around the eyes, on mucous membranes (inside the mouth, inside the nose, the vagina, etc.), on the genitals, the external genitalia, eczema, moist areas, macerated skin, or diseased areas with severe cracking or wounds, on the nails, or on the scalp. Before using this medicine, those who have experienced allergic symptoms to medicines, people with an allergic constitution, people whose diseased area is festering or is on the face or is extensive, and people who are not sure whether their condition is eczema or athlete's foot, tinea cruris or tinea corporis should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes, and if it does, rinse immediately with water or warm water. Do not touch your eyes or mucous membranes with hands that have this medicine on them. Use this medicine for external use only; do not use it internally. If there is no improvement in symptoms after using it for about 2 weeks, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

Patients hypersensitive to this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women, and infants and young children must not use this medicine. Do not use it on the eyes or the area around the eyes, mucous membranes (the oral cavity (inside the mouth), the nasal cavity (inside the nose), the vagina, etc.), the scrotum or the external genitalia, or on affected areas (diseased sites) with eczema, wetness (dampness), severe erosion, cracking or wounds, or on the nails or the scalp. Before using this medicine, those who have experienced allergic symptoms to a medicine, patients with an allergic constitution, patients whose affected area (diseased site) is on the face or is extensive or has become festering, and patients hypersensitive to propylene glycol or those who have experienced it should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Do not use it while the affected area (diseased site) or the area around it is dirty. Do not touch the eyes or mucous membranes with hands that have this medicine on them. Be careful that it does not get into the eyes, and if it does, rinse it out immediately with clean water. Use this medicine externally only. If there is no improvement in symptoms after 2 weeks of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women, and infants and children should not use this medicine. Do not use it on the eyes or the area around the eyes, on mucous membranes (inside the mouth, inside the nose, the vagina), on the scrotum or external genitalia, on eczema, on diseased areas with severe moistness (dampness), skin breakdown, cracking, or injury (wounds), on the nails, or on the scalp. Before using this medicine, people with an allergic constitution, patients whose diseased area is on the face or is widespread or has become purulent (festering), and patients with hypersensitivity to propylene glycol or those who have experienced it should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration exactly. Do not use it while the diseased area or the area around it is dirty. Do not touch your eyes or mucous membranes with hands that have this medicine on them. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes; if it does get into the eyes, rinse immediately with cold or lukewarm water. This medicine is for external use only.

Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine, women who are pregnant or may be pregnant, breastfeeding women, and infants and children must not use this medicine. Do not use it on the eyes or the area around the eyes, mucous membranes (inside the mouth, inside the nose, the vagina), the scrotum, the external genitalia, diseased areas with severe eczema, dampness (moistness), rawness, cracking or wounds (injuries), the nails, or the scalp. Before using this medicine, patients with an allergic constitution and people whose diseased area is on the face, is extensive or has become festering should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Do not use it while the diseased area or its surroundings are dirty. Do not touch the eyes or mucous membranes with hands that have this preparation on them. Be careful that it does not get into the eyes; if it does, rinse it out immediately with cold or lukewarm water. Use this medicine for external use only.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and nursing mothers, and young children and children must not use this medicine. Do not use it on or around the eyes, on mucous membranes (the mouth, the inside of the nose, the vagina), on the scrotum or the vulva, on eczema, on diseased areas with severe wetness (dampness), rawness, cracking, or injury (wounds), on the nails, or on the scalp. Before using this medicine, those with an allergic constitution, those whose diseased area is on the face or is extensive or suppurating (festering), and patients with hypersensitivity to propylene glycol or a history of it should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Do not use it while the diseased area or the area around it is dirty. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes, and if it does get into the eyes, rinse immediately with cold or lukewarm water. Use this medicine externally only.

Do not use this medicine in patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women, infants, or children, or on the eyes, around the eyes, on mucous membranes (inside the mouth, inside the nose, the vagina), the genital area, the external genitalia, or on diseased areas with severe eczema, dampness, maceration, cracking, or wounds. Before using this medicine, people with an allergic constitution, people who have experienced allergic symptoms, and patients whose diseased area is on the face or is extensive or festering should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Clean the diseased area and its surroundings before use. Be careful that it does not get into the eyes, and if it does, rinse them out immediately with water or warm water. Do not touch your eyes or mucous membranes with hands that have this medicine on them. This medicine is for external use only; do not use it internally.

Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine, women who are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding, infants, and children must not use this medicine, and it must not be used on or around the eyes, on mucous membranes (inside the mouth, inside the nose, the vagina), on the scrotum or external genitalia, on eczema, on moist (damp) areas, on erosion, on diseased areas with severe cracking or wounds, on the nails, or on the scalp. Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have an allergic constitution or have experienced allergic symptoms, if the diseased area is on the face or is extensive or festering, or if you are hypersensitive to propylene glycol or have been in the past. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Clean the diseased area and its surroundings before use. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes, and if it does get into the eyes, rinse them immediately with water or warm water. Do not touch your eyes or mucous membranes with hands that have this medicine on them. Use this medicine for external use only; do not use it internally.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine and pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women must not use this medicine, and it must not be used on mucous membranes such as the vagina, bladder or mouth, or in the eyes. Before using this medicine, patients with an allergic constitution should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use it for external use only. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes, and if it does, rinse thoroughly with clean water immediately. Do not use it on extensive wounds or burns. Since soaps weaken the disinfecting action of this medicine, wash them off thoroughly before use. Do not use it for gynecological purposes (disinfection of the vagina or external genitalia, etc.) or urological purposes (disinfection of the external genitals or mucous membranes, etc.).

entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 임부, 수유부, 2세 이하의 영아는 이 약을 복용: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, pregnant women, nursing mothers, and infants aged 2 years or younger must not take this medicine.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 임신 3기, 눈 또는 눈 주위에는 이 약을 사용하: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine and women in the 3rd trimester of pregnancy must not use this medicine, and it must not be used on or around the eyes. Before using this medicine, pregnant women (in the 1st and 2nd trimesters), patients who are allergic to medicines or cosmetics or have been in the past, and people with severe moist skin or erosion should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If there is no improvement in symptoms, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use it only on the areas with acne or pimples, and do not use it on large surrounding areas, around the eyes, on deep wounds, or on severe burns. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes. If it does get into the eyes, rinse them immediately with water or lukewarm water. If the irritation persists, consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine for external use only. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Be careful not to let it touch skin other than the area being treated.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 임신 3기, 눈, 눈 주위에는 이 약을 사용하지: Do not use this medicine in patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, in the third trimester of pregnancy, or on the eyes or around the eyes.Before using this medicine, pregnant women (in the first and second trimesters), those who have experienced allergic symptoms caused by medicines or cosmetics, those with severe moist skin or rawness, and those with hypersensitivity to propylene glycol or who have experienced allergic reactions should consult a doctor or pharmacist.Use it only on areas with acne or pimples, and do not use it on wide surrounding areas, around the eyes, on deep wounds, or on severe burns.Be careful not to let it get into the eyes, and if it does, rinse immediately with clean water.Use this medicine for external use only.Strictly observe the specified dosage and administration.Be careful not to let it come into contact with skin other than the application site.If you take this medicine by mistake, consult a doctor or pharmacist.

Do not use it on the eyes or around the eyes. Before using this medicine, pregnant women (in the first and second trimesters, only when truly necessary), patients with a history of allergic symptoms caused by medicines or cosmetics, people with severe moistness or rawness of the skin, and patients with hypersensitivity to propylene glycol or a history of it should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use it only on the areas with acne or pimples, and do not use it on large surrounding areas or around the eyes. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes, and if it does, rinse it out immediately with water or lukewarm water. Use this medicine externally only. Follow the specified dosage and administration carefully. Be careful not to let it touch skin outside the area of application.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 임신 3기는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.눈, 눈: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine and women in the third trimester of pregnancy must not use this medicine. Do not use this medicine on the eyes or around the eyes. Before using this medicine, pregnant women (in the first and second trimesters, when it is absolutely necessary), those who have experienced allergic symptoms caused by medicines or cosmetics, and patients with severe moist skin or maceration should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes, and if it does, rinse immediately with water or lukewarm water. Use this medicine for external use only. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. If you swallow this medicine by mistake, consult a doctor or pharmacist.

entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 임신 또는 임신하고 있을 가능성이 있는 여성, 수: Patients hypersensitive to this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant, breastfeeding women, children under 15 years of age, patients with or with a history of gastrointestinal ulcer or bleeding, patients with or with a history of bronchial asthma, patients with difficulty breathing due to asthma attacks, emphysema, or chronic bronchitis, patients with or with a history of hypersensitivity to aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics such as asthma, urticaria, or allergic reactions, patients with severe blood abnormalities, liver impairment, cardiac insufficiency, or high blood pressure, patients with glaucoma, lower urinary tract obstructive disease such as benign prostatic hyperplasia, convulsive disorders such as epilepsy, or pheochromocytoma, and patients with pain occurring before or after coronary artery bypass surgery must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, people who have experienced hypersensitivity, patients with chickenpox, patients with or with a history of blood abnormalities, liver cirrhosis, liver impairment, or kidney impairment, patients with a tendency to bleed, patients with cardiac insufficiency or heart disease or high blood pressure, patients with systemic lupus erythematosus or mixed connective tissue disease, patients with ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease, myasthenia gravis, diabetes, or thyroid disease, elderly people aged 65 years and over, and children should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If symptoms do not improve after taking it for 5 days or more, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not take more than the recommended dose of this medicine. Breastfeeding women should either stop breastfeeding or stop taking this medicine. It may affect reaction time. Take care when driving or operating machinery. Children should take it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Do not take it continuously for a long period. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 장내벽의 구조적, 기능적 장애로 인한 장천공 또는: Patients hypersensitive to this medicine, and patients with severe inflammatory bowel disease such as intestinal perforation or intestinal obstruction due to structural or functional disorder of the intestinal wall, Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis or toxic megacolon, must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, children under 12 years of age and pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a doctor or pharmacist.

Before using this medicine, pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. It turns the urine yellow, which may affect clinical test values. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 1 month, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 중증(심한 증상)의 간 및 신기능 장애, 중증(심: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, patients with severe liver and kidney dysfunction, severe coronary heart disease, urination disorder, high blood pressure, or coronary artery disease, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant, nursing mothers, infants aged 2 years or younger, and patients with hypersensitivity to methylparaben must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients with asthma, glaucoma, arrhythmia, diabetes, or hyperthyroidism, and children under 12 years of age, should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
