Use this medicine only for instillation, that is, as a medicine put into the eye. After opening, use it only 1 time, and discard the remaining solution and the container after instilling it in the eye. If symptoms do not improve after about 2 weeks of use, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. When using it for the first time, discard 1 to 2 drops without instilling them, in order to remove any fragments of the container that may be produced when it is opened. Do not let the tip of the container touch the eyelids or eyelashes. If it does, the solution may become contaminated or cloudy because of eye mucus, mold, and the like. Also, do not use medicine that has become cloudy. To prevent contamination, do not share it with others. Children should use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully.

Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, patients with significant corneal damage should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine only for instillation, that is, as a medicine put into the eye. Use it only 1 time after opening, and discard the remaining solution and the container after putting it into the eye. If the symptoms do not improve after about 2 weeks of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. When using it for the first time, discard the first 1 to 2 drops without instilling them in order to remove any container fragments that may be produced when opening it. Do not let the tip of the container touch the eyelid or eyelashes. If it does, the solution may become contaminated or cloudy from eye mucus or mold. Also, do not use the medicine if it has become cloudy. To prevent contamination, do not share it with others. Children should use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, patients with significant corneal damage should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving this medicine to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use this medicine for instillation into the eye only. When using it for the first time, discard the first 1 to 2 drops without instilling them (to remove any container fragments produced when opening it). Be careful, because if the tip of the container touches the eyelid or eyelashes the solution may become contaminated or cloudy from eye mucus or mold, and do not use it if it has become cloudy. To prevent contamination, avoid sharing it with others as far as possible.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine should not use it. Before using this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women, patients with bronchial asthma or accompanying respiratory insufficiency, elderly people, and children should consult a doctor or pharmacist. It is not used as an injection or as eye drops. After nebulization therapy the face mask may stick to the face, but it comes off easily when washed with water.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine must not use it. Before using this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant, nursing mothers, and children should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not use an occlusive dressing or wrapping unless directed by a doctor. In the case of candidiasis, do not use acidic soap. Apply this medicine externally only. Do not use it on acute inflammation or on open wound areas. Be careful not to let it touch the eyes, nose, mouth, or other mucous membranes.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, a pregnant woman or a woman who may be pregnant and a breast-feeding woman, and children, should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Apply this medicine externally only. Do not use this medicine for the eyes, apply it carefully so that it does not touch the eyes, and if it gets into the eyes by mistake, rinse them out completely with plenty of water. Do not use it on a scalp with a wound or inflammation or on an area of severe erosion.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, women who are pregnant or may be pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not use this medicine during menstruation. While using this medicine, do not use tampons, vaginal douching, cleansers, or other products inserted into the vagina. If a vaginal infection occurs, or while you are using this product, it is best to avoid vaginal intercourse, and there is a possibility that your partner may become infected during intercourse. Do not let the medicine touch the eyes and do not swallow it. Use this medicine only in the vagina; do not use it internally. This medicine may weaken latex or rubber products such as condoms and contraceptive diaphragms, so take care.

Patients hypersensitive to this medicine must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and patients hypersensitive to propylene glycol or who have experienced an allergic reaction to it should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If no improvement in symptoms is achieved after about 7 days of use, or if symptoms become worse after use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist

Patients hypersensitive to this medicine must not use it. Before using this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use this medicine on the anal area only; do not use it in the eyes. If there is no improvement in symptoms after about 7 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, pregnant and breastfeeding women and patients with vaginal bleeding or leukorrhea should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Check whether the packaging is damaged, and do not use it if it is damaged. This is a single-use product; do not reuse it. If there is no improvement in symptoms after using it for up to 7 days, consult a doctor or pharmacist.

Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, patients whose affected area is extensive should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine for external use only. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes, and if it does get into the eyes, rinse them immediately with clean water.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.체표면적의 10 % 까: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine must not use this medicine. Use it on no more than 10 % of the body surface area, and avoid contact with the eyes, middle ear, meninges, and brain. Since this is a single-use product, using it on more than one patient may cause cross-contamination or infection. Use it with caution in newborns, especially premature infants, because it may cause chemical burns to the skin.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.코에만 사용하십시오.복: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine must not use this medicine. Use it only in the nose. Do not take it internally or use it in the eyes or ears. To prevent contamination, do not share it with others. Children should use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Do not use it for more than 12 weeks after opening.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 6개월 미만의 영아, 헤파린 과민반응, 출혈경향 및 저: Do not use this medicine in those with hypersensitivity to this medicine, infants under 6 months of age, those with hypersensitivity reactions to heparin, patients with a bleeding tendency or thrombocytopenia, or pregnant women, or on incised or unhealed wounds, mucous membranes, and/or suppurative infection sites.Before using this medicine, breastfeeding women and infants under 2 years of age should consult a doctor or pharmacist.Do not apply it around the eyes or on mucous membranes.Be careful not to expose the scar to the heat of the sun or to light.When using it in children, do so under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.For children, especially infants, fixing it with a bandage and leaving it on overnight is not appropriate.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 6개월 미만의 영아, 헤파린 과민증, 출혈경향 및 저혈: People with hypersensitivity to this medicine, infants under 6 months of age, patients with hypersensitivity to heparin, a bleeding tendency, or thrombocytopenia, incised or unhealed wounds, mucous membranes or purulent infected areas, and pregnant women must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, breastfeeding women and infants under 2 years of age should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not apply it around the eyes or on mucous membranes. Be careful that the scar is not exposed to the heat of the sun or to light. For children, especially infants, it is not appropriate to fix it in place with a bandage and leave it on for one evening. When it is used on children, use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 6세 미만의 소아는 이 약을 복용하지 마십시오.이 약을: Patients hypersensitive to this medicine and children under 6 years of age must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, pregnant women and breastfeeding women and children aged 6 years and over but under 12 years should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not use it immediately before or immediately after brushing the teeth. Avoid contact with the eyes.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 갈락토오스 불내성, Lapp 유당분해효소 결핍증 또는: Patients hypersensitive to this medicine, patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption, those who have experienced hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to soybean oil, and patients hypersensitive to soybeans or peanuts must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant, those who have experienced hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to Yellow No. 4, patients with abnormal fat metabolism such as hyperlipoproteinemia, diabetic hyperlipidemia or pancreatitis, patients for whom lipid emulsions must be administered with caution, and those who have experienced hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to Yellow No. 5 should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 감염성 또는 삼출성 피부병 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine and patients with infectious or exudative skin disease should not use this medicine. Avoid contact with the eyes. If you have applied this medicine to treat cracked nipples while breastfeeding, wipe it off before breastfeeding.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 갑상선기능 이상 환자(특히 결절성 갑상선종, 지방병성: This medicine must not be used by patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, by patients with thyroid dysfunction (especially nodular goiter, endemic goiter, Hashimoto's thyroiditis, etc.), by patients with renal failure, by newborns and infants under 6 months of age, by patients with dermatitis herpetiformis, or by patients before or after radioactive iodine treatment. Before using this medicine, patients in a serious condition (burn patients, etc.), patients who have had a thyroid disease, patients who have had renal failure, and pregnant or breast-feeding women should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If it has been used right before delivery, wash the newborn's eyes and bathe the baby as soon as possible after the delivery so that the medicine does not remain on the skin. Do not use it for the eyes or internally. If the undiluted solution gets into the eyes, rinse them out immediately with clean water. Do not mix it with other preparations for use. When this medicine is used on a patient with extensive burns, provide sufficient fluids. Because this medicine has a spermicidal action, do not use it if pregnancy is desired.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, patients with thyroid dysfunction (especially nodular goiter, endemic goiter, Hashimoto's thyroiditis, etc.), patients with renal failure, newborns and infants under 6 months of age, patients with dermatitis herpetiformis, and patients before or after radioactive iodine treatment must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, seriously ill patients (such as burn patients), those with a history of thyroid disease, and those with a history of renal failure should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If it is used just before delivery, wash the newborn's eyes and bathe the baby as soon as possible after delivery, taking care that the medicine does not remain on the baby. Do not use this medicine in the eyes or take it by mouth. If the undiluted solution gets into the eyes, rinse it out. Do not mix it with other preparations. Soap weakens the germicidal action of this medicine, so wash it off thoroughly before use. For details, please refer to the approved labeling.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 갑상선기능 이상 환자, 6세 미만의 소아, 방사성요오드: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine, patients with thyroid dysfunction, children under 6 years of age, and patients who are undergoing radioactive iodine therapy or are before or after such therapy must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, patients with severe sores in the mouth and women who are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use it for the mouth only.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 고칼슘혈증(혈액중에 칼슘이 과잉으로 존재하는 상태),: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine, patients with hypercalcemia (a condition in which there is an excess of calcium in the blood), sarcoidosis (a systemic inflammatory disease of unknown cause) or kidney disease, infants under 12 months of age, patients with kidney stones or severe renal failure, people who have experienced hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to soybean oil, and patients who are hypersensitive to soybeans or peanuts must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients with hyperoxaluria (a condition in which excessive oxalate is excreted in the urine), women who are pregnant or may be pregnant, breastfeeding women, premature infants, young children, patients with gastrointestinal disease such as peptic ulcer, chronic ulcerative colitis or regional enteritis, patients with cardiac and circulatory function disorders, kidney disorder, hypoproteinemia, gout, or kidney stones or a history of them, pregnant women, patients with disorders of fat metabolism such as hyperlipoproteinemia, diabetic hyperlipidemia or pancreatitis, patients to whom lipid emulsions must be given with caution, patients with a predisposition to thrombosis (blockage of the blood vessels), patients who are deficient in folic acid, and patients for whom fat overload poses a particular risk should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 1 month, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. It may interfere with the detection of glucose in various urine tests, and it turns the urine yellow, which may affect clinical test values.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 다른 해열진통제, 감기약 복용 시 천식 경험자, 만 2: Those with hypersensitivity to this medicine, those who have experienced asthma when taking other antipyretic analgesics or cold remedies, children under 2 years of age, and infants (babies and newborns) under 3 months of age must not take this medicine. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving this medicine to children, use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Drowsiness may occur after taking this medicine, so be careful when driving or operating machinery.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 다른 해열진통제, 감기약 복용 시 천식 경험자, 만 3: People with hypersensitivity to this medicine, people who have experienced asthma when taking other antipyretic analgesics or cold remedies, infants under 3 months of age and children under 2 years of age, and people who are taking an MAO inhibitor (antidepressants, antipsychotics, mood regulators, antiparkinsonian drugs, etc.) or who stopped taking one within the past 2 weeks should not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, infants and children under 15 years of age who are infected with or suspected of having chickenpox or influenza, people with an allergic constitution, people who have experienced allergic symptoms from medicines (e.g., fever, rash, joint pain, asthma, itching, etc.), people with liver disease, kidney disease, heart disease, thyroid disease, diabetes, high blood pressure, gastroduodenal ulcer, glaucoma (e.g., eye pain, blurred vision, etc.), or difficulty urinating, elderly people, people who are physically weak or have a high fever, people whose gastrointestinal problems such as heartburn, stomach discomfort, or stomach pain persist or recur or who have ulcers or bleeding problems, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women, and patients with smoking, asthma, chronic bronchitis, or emphysema, a cough accompanied by excessive phlegm, a cough that lasts 1 week or more or recurs, a chronic cough, or a cough accompanied by fever, rash, or persistent headache should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration exactly. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Drowsiness may occur after taking it, so be careful when driving or operating machinery. If there is no improvement in symptoms after 5 to 6 doses, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 만 12개월 미만의 젖먹이, 심한 신부전 환자는 이 약: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, infants under 12 months of age, and patients with severe renal failure must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, infants under 1 year of age, patients who are under a doctor's treatment, pregnant women and women who may be pregnant, nursing mothers, premature infants, young children, and patients with cardiac and circulatory dysfunction, kidney (renal) disorder, or hypoproteinemia should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When it is used for children, use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. It may turn the urine yellow and affect clinical laboratory test values.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 만 12개월 미만의 젖먹이, 심한 증상의 신부전 환자는: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, nursing infants under 12 months of age, and patients with severe renal failure must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, pregnant women and women who may be pregnant, breastfeeding women, premature infants, young children, and patients with cardiac and circulatory system function disorders, kidney disorder, or hypoproteinemia should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. It may turn the urine yellow and thereby affect clinical test values.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 만 3개월 미만의 젖먹이, 대두유·콩·땅콩에 과민증 또: Those with hypersensitivity to this medicine, infants under 3 months of age, and those with hypersensitivity to soybean oil, soy, or peanuts or who have experienced allergic reactions to them must not take this medicine.Before taking this medicine, infants under 1 year of age, pregnant women and women who may be pregnant, breastfeeding women, premature infants, young children, and patients with abnormalities of fat metabolism such as hyperlipoproteinemia, diabetic hyperlipidemia, or pancreatitis, or patients to whom lipid emulsions must be administered with caution, should consult a doctor or pharmacist.Strictly observe the specified dosage and administration.It may interfere with the detection of glucose in various urine tests and may turn the urine yellow, affecting clinical test values.When administering to children, do so under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.If there is no improvement in symptoms after about 1 month of taking it, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
People who are hypersensitive to this medicine and nursing infants under 3 months of age must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if the user is a nursing infant under 1 year of age, if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding, or if the user is a premature infant or a young child. This medicine contains sodium benzoate, and benzoic acid can be a mild irritant to the skin, eyes, and mucous membranes. Take this medicine by mouth only; do not use it for injection. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. It may turn the urine yellow and thereby affect clinical test values. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 1 month, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 만 6세 미만의 소아, 뇌경질막이 노출되는 수술이나 나: Those with hypersensitivity to this medicine, children under 6 years of age, people who have undergone surgery exposing the dura mater or transsphenoidal hypophysectomy, patients with closed-angle glaucoma, rhinitis sicca or atrophic rhinitis, and people who are taking MAO inhibitors (antidepressants, antipsychotics, mood regulators, antiparkinsonian agents, etc.) or are within 2 weeks of stopping them must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, people with an allergic constitution, those who have experienced allergic symptoms caused by medicines (including nasal sprays for rhinitis) (for example, fever, rash and redness, swelling, irritation, joint pain, asthma, itching, etc.), people with high blood pressure, cardiovascular disease, hyperthyroidism, diabetes, pheochromocytoma, benign prostatic hyperplasia, insomnia or dizziness, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant, breastfeeding women, and patients with smoking, asthma, chronic bronchitis, emphysema, cough with excessive phlegm, cough lasting or recurring for 1 week or more, chronic cough, or cough accompanied by fever, rash or persistent headache should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When using it for children, use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use this medicine only as a nasal spray for rhinitis (nasal inflammation), and do not use it in the eyes or ears. Do not use it continuously for 1 week or more. If there is no improvement in symptoms after 3 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 만 7세 미만의 어린이, 만 2세 미만의 영아(젖먹이): People with hypersensitivity to this medicine, children under 7 years of age, and infants (nursing babies) under 2 years of age must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, people with urticaria, contact dermatitis, migraine, or a food allergy constitution, people who have had allergic reactions (e.g., fever, rash and redness (reddening of the skin), swelling (puffiness), irritation, joint pain, asthma, itching, etc.), patients with high blood pressure, heart disease, diabetes, thyroid disease, or glaucoma, women who are pregnant or may be pregnant, people who are under treatment by a doctor or dentist, patients with cough (smoking, asthma, chronic bronchitis, emphysema, a cough with excessive phlegm, a cough lasting 1 week or longer or recurring, a chronic cough, a cough accompanied by fever and rash or a persistent headache), and people with hypersensitivity to propylene glycol or who have experienced allergic reactions to it should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the specified dosage and administration carefully. Use this medicine only as a spray for rhinitis (nasal inflammation), and do not use it in the eyes or ears. To prevent contamination, do not share it with others as far as possible. Do not use it continuously for more than 7 days. Drowsiness may occur after use, so take care when driving or operating machinery. When it is given to children, give it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 병소(아픈 부위)에 2차 감염 환자는 이 약을 사용하지: This medicine must not be used by patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine or by patients with a secondary infection at the lesion (the painful area). Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if the user is a pregnant woman or a woman who may be pregnant, has a mucosal wound at the application site, sepsis, epilepsy, a cardiac conduction abnormality, bradycardia, impaired liver function or severe shock, or has or has had hypersensitivity to propylene glycol. Use it only on painful areas with mild symptoms. Do not use it for the eyes.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 세균(결핵, 매독 등)ㆍ진균(칸디다증, 백선 등)ㆍ단순: Do not use this medicine in patients hypersensitive to it, in patients with bacterial (tuberculosis, syphilis, etc.), fungal (candidiasis, tinea, etc.), viral (herpes zoster, chickenpox, vaccinia, etc., excluding herpes simplex), or animal-borne (scabies, pubic lice, etc.) skin infections, in patients whose immune system is severely impaired such as bone marrow transplant patients or AIDS patients, in patients with eczematous otitis externa with a perforated eardrum, ulcers (excluding Behcet's disease), burns or frostbite of deep second degree or worse, perioral dermatitis, acne vulgaris, or rosacea, in breastfeeding women, in children under 18 years of age, in patients with or with a history of myocardial infarction, or on the eyes, nose, inside of the mouth, or genitals. Before using this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and elderly people should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not breastfeed while using this medicine. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 세균(결핵, 매독 등)ㆍ진균(칸디다증, 백선 등)ㆍ스피: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, skin infections caused by bacteria (tuberculosis, syphilis, etc.), fungi (candidiasis, tinea, etc.), spirochetes, yeasts, viruses (herpes zoster, herpes simplex, chickenpox, vaccinia, etc.) or animal parasites (scabies, pubic lice, etc.), eczematous otitis externa with a perforated eardrum, ulcers (excluding Behcet's disease), deep second-degree or worse burns or frostbite, perioral dermatitis, acne vulgaris or rosacea, and those with hypersensitivity to aminoglycoside antibiotics such as streptomycin, kanamycin, gentamicin or neomycin, or to bacitracin, or who have experienced it, must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women, and infants and young children should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Do not use it for a long period. When used for a child, use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Do not use an occlusive dressing without a doctor's supervision. Do not use it in the eyes. Do not use it for purposes other than treatment, such as after applying makeup or shaving.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, skin infections caused by bacteria (tuberculosis, syphilis, etc.), fungi (candidiasis, ringworm, etc.), spirochetes, yeasts, viruses (herpes zoster, herpes simplex, chickenpox, vaccinia, etc.), or animal parasites (scabies, pubic lice, etc.), eczematous otitis externa with perforation of the eardrum, ulcers (excluding Behcet's disease), deep second-degree or more severe burns and frostbite, perioral dermatitis, acne vulgaris, rosacea, and patients with hypersensitivity to aminoglycoside antibiotics such as streptomycin, kanamycin, gentamicin, and neomycin, or to bacitracin should not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, people who have experienced hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to propylene glycol, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women, and infants and children should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration exactly. When using it in a child, use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Avoid long-term or large-volume use and occlusive dressings. Do not use it for the eyes. It is not used for purposes other than treatment, such as with makeup or after shaving. If there is no improvement in symptoms after 3 to 4 weeks of treatment, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 소화성궤양, 심한 혈액 이상, 간장애, 신장(콩팥)장애: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine, patients with peptic ulcer, severe blood abnormalities, liver disorder, kidney disorder or reduced heart function, and patients with aspirin-induced asthma (asthma attacks triggered by non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs) or who have experienced it must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients with liver disorder, kidney disorder, peptic ulcer or blood abnormalities or who have experienced these, patients with a tendency to bleed, abnormal heart function, hypersensitivity or bronchial asthma, the elderly, children under 2 years of age, and pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 소화성궤양, 심한 혈액 이상, 간장애, 신장장애, 심장: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, peptic ulcer, severe blood abnormalities, liver disorder, kidney disorder, or reduced cardiac function, and patients with or with a history of aspirin-induced asthma must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients with or with a history of liver disorder or kidney disorder, people who have had peptic ulcer, patients with or with a history of blood abnormalities, patients with a bleeding tendency or abnormal cardiac function, people who have experienced hypersensitivity, patients with bronchial asthma, the elderly, children under 2 years of age, pregnant women, and breastfeeding women should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Children and the elderly should take the minimum necessary amount and be alert for adverse reactions. In particular, in children and the elderly with a high fever and in patients with wasting diseases, observe their condition carefully after they take it. Without instructions from a doctor or pharmacist, adults must not take it for more than 10 days and children must not take it for more than 5 days for pain, and it must not be taken for more than 3 days for fever. If pain or fever persists or worsens, or if new symptoms appear, consult a doctor or pharmacist.

entries.이 약에 과민증, 소화성궤양, 심한 혈액 이상, 심한 간장애, 심한 신장: People with hypersensitivity to this medicine, peptic ulcer, severe blood abnormalities, severe liver disorder, severe kidney disorder, or severe cardiac dysfunction, and people with aspirin-induced asthma or a history of it must not take this medicine. entries.이 약은 경구중독의 해독제로서 사용할 때, 약용탄과 이페칵(토근)시럽의: When this medicine is used as an antidote for oral poisoning, giving medicinal charcoal together with ipecac syrup is not recommended, because the ipecac syrup is adsorbed by the medicinal charcoal and vomiting is thereby prevented. If ipecac syrup and medicinal charcoal are used together, it is recommended that the medicinal charcoal be given after vomiting has been induced and completed. This medicine should be given after gastric aspiration or gastric lavage has been completed with the involvement of a doctor. Within 2 hours of giving medicinal charcoal, the charcoal adsorbs other medicines and therefore reduces their effect. This medicine may colour the stool black.

entries.이 약은 고령자의 건피증, 성인의 거친 피부, 발뒤꿈치 및 복사뼈 부위의: This medicine is used for xeroderma in the elderly, rough skin in adults, and keratosis of the heels and ankle bones.
entries.이 약은 과민증 환자, 장폐색(창자막힘), 원인불명의 복통 또는 출혈,: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, intestinal obstruction (blocked bowel), abdominal pain or bleeding of unknown cause, fecal impaction, galactosemia, an ileal or rectal incision, inflammatory bowel disease (ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease, etc.), or a colostomy, and nursing mothers must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant, infants, young children and children, elderly or frail people, and patients with fluid and electrolyte imbalance or chronic constipation should consult a doctor or pharmacist. It is advisable to maintain an adequate fluid intake every day. If constipation does not improve after taking it for about 1 week, stop taking it and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

Consult a doctor or pharmacist when using it together with lithium, chlorhexidine, sulfadiazine and silver compounds, alkalis, preparations containing mercury, or enzyme-based wound treatments. entries.이 약은 눈의 건조 또는 바람·태양에 노출되어 생기는 화끈거리는 증상,: This medicine is used for the temporary relief of burning, irritation and discomfort caused by dryness of the eyes or by exposure to wind and sun.
entries.이 약은 눈의 건조 또는 바람·태양에 의한 화끈거리는 증상, 자극감, 불: This medicine is used for the temporary relief of a burning sensation, irritation, and discomfort caused by dryness of the eyes or by wind and sun, and for the prevention of eye irritation.
entries.이 약은 눈의 건조 또는 바람이나 태양에 노출되어 생기는 화끈거리는 증상: This medicine is used for the temporary relief of dryness of the eye or of the burning sensation, irritation, and discomfort caused by exposure to wind or sun.
This medicine is used to relieve dry eye symptoms and to temporarily reduce irritation.
entries.이 약은 눈의 피로, 결막충혈, 수영 후 눈의 불쾌감 또는 먼지나 땀이: This medicine is used for eye fatigue, conjunctival congestion, eye discomfort after swimming or when dust or sweat gets into the eyes, eye inflammation caused by ultraviolet and other light rays, sore eyelids, discomfort when wearing hard contact lenses, itchy eyes, and blurred vision such as when there is a lot of eye discharge.

This medicine is used for eye fatigue, congestion of the conjunctiva, discomfort in the eyes after swimming or when dust or sweat has got into the eyes, inflammation of the eyes caused by ultraviolet and other rays, raw and sore eyelids, discomfort when wearing hard contact lenses, itching of the eyes, and blurred vision (such as when there is a lot of eye mucus).

This medicine is used for eye fatigue, conjunctival congestion, discomfort in the eyes after swimming or when dust or sweat has got into the eyes, inflammation of the eyes caused by ultraviolet rays and other light, sore eyelids, discomfort when wearing hard contact lenses, itching of the eyes, blurred vision, and when there is a lot of eye discharge.
entries.이 약은 눈의 피로, 눈물의 보조(눈의 건조), 하드콘택트렌즈 또는 소프: This medicine is used for eye fatigue, as a supplement to tears (dryness of the eyes), discomfort when wearing hard or soft contact lenses, and blurred vision (such as when there is a lot of eye discharge).

This medicine is used for eye fatigue, supplementing tears (dryness of the eyes), discomfort when wearing hard contact lenses or soft lenses, and blurriness of the eyes (such as when there is a lot of eye mucus).
entries.이 약은 눈의 피로, 눈물의 보조, 하드콘택트렌즈 또는 소프트렌즈 착용: This medicine is used for eye fatigue, as a supplement to tears, for discomfort when wearing hard contact lenses or soft lenses, and for blurred vision.
entries.이 약은 눈의 피로, 눈의 건조에 대한 눈물의 보조, 하드콘택트렌즈 또는: This medicine is used for eye fatigue, as a supplement to tears for dryness of the eye, for discomfort when wearing hard contact lenses or soft lenses, and for blurred vision such as when there is a lot of eye mucus.
entries.이 약은 눈의 피로, 눈의 건조에 대한 눈물의 보조, 하드콘택트렌즈 착용: This medicine is used for eye fatigue, as a supplement to tears for dry eyes, for discomfort while wearing hard contact lenses, and for dimness of the eyes such as when there is a lot of eye mucus.
entries.이 약은 눈의 피로, 눈의 침침함(눈곱이 많을 때 등), 하드콘택트렌즈: This medicine is used for eye fatigue, blurred vision (such as when there is a lot of eye mucus), discomfort when wearing hard or soft contact lenses, discomfort in the eyes after swimming, and when dust or sweat gets into the eyes.
entries.이 약은 다음과 같은 순서대로 사용합니다.어플리케이터의 포장을 벗기고 스: Use this medicine in the following order. Remove the applicator from its packaging and hold it with the sponge facing downwards. Do not touch the sponge part of the applicator. Squeeze the applicator firmly only once so that the ampoule breaks and the solution comes out, and leave the broken ampoule inside the applicator. For the 26 mL product, squeeze the lever on the handle firmly, and for the other products squeeze both wings firmly. Do not squeeze or press the wings repeatedly in order to wet the sponge quickly. Press and release the sponge against the treatment area until the solution is visible on the skin, wetting the sponge and completely wetting the treatment area with the solution. For a dry surgical site (e.g. the abdomen or an arm), once the solution is visible on the skin, rub gently back and forth for 30 seconds to treat that area. For a moist surgical site (e.g. the groin fold), rub gently back and forth repeatedly for about 2 minutes. Let the area to which the solution has been applied dry completely in the air, and do not wipe the solution off. Discard the applicator after a single use, together with any remaining solution that was not used on the treatment area. It is not necessary to use the entire amount.
entries.이 약은 단순포진(물집) 바이러스 감염증(초기 및 재발성 생식기 포진(물: This medicine is used for herpes simplex (blister) virus infections (including initial and recurrent genital herpes (blisters) and cold sores (blisters) on the lips).
entries.이 약은 당뇨병에 의한 망막변성 및 눈의 혈관장애 개선과 야맹증에 사용합: This medicine is used to improve retinal degeneration and vascular disorders of the eye caused by diabetes, and for night blindness.
entries.이 약은 두통, 치통, 발치 후 통증, 인후통, 귀의 통증, 관절통, 신: This medicine is used for the relief of pain from headache, toothache, pain after tooth extraction, sore throat, earache, joint pain, neuralgia, back pain, muscle pain, stiff shoulders, bruise pain, fracture pain, sprain pain (pain from a twist), menstrual pain (period pain), and pain from injury, and for the reduction of fever when there are chills and fever.
entries.이 약은 두통, 치통, 발치(이를 뽑음)후 동통(통증), 인후(목구멍)통: This medicine is used for the relief of headache, toothache, pain after tooth extraction (having a tooth pulled), sore throat, earache, joint pain, neuralgia, low back pain, muscle pain, shoulder pain (stiff shoulders, shoulder ache), bruise pain, fracture pain, sprain pain (pain from a sprain), menstrual pain (period pain), and pain from trauma (wounds), and for reducing fever when there are chills (feeling cold and shivering) and fever.

entries.이 약은 두통, 치통, 발치후 동통(통증), 인후통, 귀의 통증, 관절통: This medicine is used for the relief of headache, toothache, pain after tooth extraction, sore throat, earache, joint pain, neuralgia, back pain, muscle pain, shoulder pain (stiff shoulders), bruise pain, fracture pain, sprain pain, menstrual pain and pain from injury, and for reducing fever when there are chills and fever.

entries.이 약은 두통, 치통, 발치후 통증, 인후통, 귀의 통증, 관절통, 신경: This medicine is used for the relief of pain from headache, toothache, pain after tooth extraction, sore throat, earache, joint pain, neuralgia, back pain, muscle pain, stiff shoulders, bruise pain, fracture pain, sprain pain, menstrual pain (period pain), and pain from injury, and for the reduction of fever when there are chills and fever.

This medicine is used for the relief of headache, toothache, pain after tooth extraction, sore throat, earache, joint pain, neuralgia, low back pain, muscle pain, stiff shoulders, bruise pain, fracture pain, sprain pain, menstrual pain (period pain), and trauma pain, and for reducing fever when there are chills and fever.
entries.이 약은 류마티양 관절염, 골관절염(퇴행성 관절질환), 강직성 척추염,: This medicine is used for rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis (degenerative joint disease), ankylosing spondylitis, tendinitis (inflammation of the tendons), acute gout, dysmenorrhea, bursitis (inflammation of the synovial bursa), skeletal muscle disorders (sprains, contusions (bruises), trauma (wounds), lumbosacral pain (low back pain)), pain after surgery, migraine, and pain after tooth extraction (having a tooth pulled).

This drug is used for rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis (degenerative joint disease), ankylosing spondylitis, tendinitis, acute gout, dysmenorrhea and bursitis, skeletal muscle disorders (sprain, contusion (bruise), trauma (wound), lumbosacral pain (low back pain)), postoperative pain (aches), migraine, and pain after tooth extraction (pulling out a tooth).
entries.이 약은 류마티양 관절염, 연소성 류마티양 관절염, 골관절염(퇴행성 관절: This medicine is used for rheumatoid arthritis, juvenile rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis (degenerative joint disease), fever and pain caused by a cold, low back pain, dysmenorrhea, postoperative pain, ankylosing spondylitis, headache, toothache, muscle pain, neuralgia, acute gout, psoriatic arthritis, soft tissue injury (sprain, contusion) and non-articular rheumatic disease (tendinitis, tenosynovitis, bursitis).

entries.이 약은 류마티양 관절염, 연소성 류마티양 관절염, 골관절염, 감기로 인: This medicine is used for rheumatoid arthritis, juvenile rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, fever and pain due to a cold, low back pain, dysmenorrhea, postoperative pain and ankylosing spondylitis, headache, toothache, muscle pain, neuralgia, acute gout, psoriatic arthritis, soft tissue injuries (sprains, contusions), and non-articular rheumatic diseases (tendinitis, tenosynovitis, bursitis).

entries.이 약은 만성 간질환의 간기능 개선, 간기능 장애에 의한 육체피로, 전신: This medicine is used to improve liver function in chronic liver disease and to improve physical fatigue and general malaise caused by impaired liver function.
entries.이 약은 만성 다발성 관절염, 류마티스 관절염, 관절증, 강직척추염에 사: This medicine is used for chronic polyarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, arthrosis and ankylosing spondylitis. This medicine is used as an adjunct in the treatment of painful swelling or inflammation after injury and surgery, and of infections accompanied by inflammation, pain and fever.

This medicine is used for chronic polyarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, arthrosis, and ankylosing spondylitis. This medicine is used as an adjunct in the treatment of painful swelling or inflammation after injury and surgery and of infections accompanied by inflammation, pain, and fever.
entries.이 약은 만성 다발성 관절염, 류마티스관절염, 관절증, 강직척추염, 외상: This medicine is used as an adjunct in the treatment of chronic polyarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, arthropathy, ankylosing spondylitis, painful swelling or inflammation after trauma and surgery, and infections accompanied by inflammation, pain, and fever.
entries.이 약은 만성 염증성 기관지 질환의 증상 개선, 기침을 동반한 호흡기의: This medicine is used to improve the symptoms of chronic inflammatory bronchial disease and to relieve acute inflammation of the respiratory tract accompanied by cough.
entries.이 약은 만성변비, 영·유아 및 소아의 변비, 분만 후의 변비에 사용합니: This medicine is used for chronic constipation, constipation in infants, young children, and children, and constipation after childbirth.
This medicine is used for chronic constipation.
entries.이 약은 먼지, 바람, 건조한 공기, 장기간의 컴퓨터사용에 의한 눈의 건: This medicine is used to moisten the eye in cases of a dry feeling, a foreign body sensation, or a feeling of fatigue in the eye caused by dust, wind, dry air, or prolonged computer use, and discomfort caused by wearing contact lenses.
entries.이 약은 멀미에 의한 어지러움 ∙ 구토 ∙ 두통의 예방 및 완화에 사용합: This medicine is used for the prevention and relief of dizziness, vomiting and headache caused by motion sickness.
entries.이 약은 멀미에 의한 어지러움, 구토, 두통의 예방 및 완화에 사용합니다: This medicine is used to prevent and relieve dizziness, vomiting, and headache caused by motion sickness.
This medicine is used for the prevention and relief of dizziness, vomiting and headache caused by motion sickness.

This medicine is used to prevent and relieve dizziness, vomiting, and headache caused by motion sickness.
This medicine is used for the prevention and relief of dizziness, vomiting and headache caused by motion sickness.
entries.이 약은 목(인후)의 염증으로 인한 목의 통증, 목의 부종, 목의 불쾌감: This medicine is used for throat pain, throat swelling, throat discomfort, and hoarseness caused by inflammation of the throat (pharynx), and for stomatitis.
entries.이 약은 무좀, 완선(사타구니 백선), 백선 등 피부사상균에 의한 피부진: This medicine is used for fungal skin infections caused by dermatophytes, such as athlete's foot, tinea cruris (ringworm of the groin), and ringworm.

entries.이 약은 미란(짓무름) 또는 궤양을 수반하는 난치성 구내염(입안염) 및: This medicine is used to relieve inflammation caused by intractable stomatitis (inflammation inside the mouth) and glossitis (inflammation of the tongue) accompanied by erosion (skin breakdown) or ulcers.
entries.이 약은 바람, 연기, 공해, 먼지, 건조한 열, 에어컨, 항공 여행,: This medicine is used for dryness of the eye and eye fatigue accompanied by discomfort, stabbing pain, or irritation caused by wind, smoke, pollution, dust, dry heat, air conditioning, air travel, prolonged computer use, and the like.

This medicine is used for dryness and fatigue of the eyes with discomfort, a stinging pain or irritation caused by wind, smoke, pollution, dust, dry heat, air conditioning, air travel, long hours of computer use and the like.
entries.이 약은 바람, 연기, 공해, 먼지, 건조한 열, 에어컨, 항공여행, 장: This medicine is used for dryness of the eyes (discomfort, stabbing pain, irritation) or eye fatigue caused by wind, smoke, pollution, dust, dry heat, air conditioning, air travel, or prolonged computer use.

This medicine is used for dryness of the eye (discomfort, stinging pain, irritation) or eye fatigue caused by wind, smoke, pollution, dust, dry heat, air conditioning, air travel, or long hours of computer use.

This medicine is used for dry eyes and eye fatigue with discomfort, stinging pain and irritation caused by wind, smoke, pollution, dust, dry heat, air conditioning, air travel or prolonged computer use.
entries.이 약은 바람, 연기, 공해, 먼지, 건조한 혈, 에어컨, 항공여행, 장: This medicine is used for dryness of the eyes (discomfort, a stabbing pain, irritation) and eye fatigue caused by wind, smoke, pollution, dust, dry air, air conditioning, air travel or long periods of computer use.
entries.이 약은 배에 피하지방이 많고 변비기가 있는 환자의 고혈압의 동반증상(두: This medicine is used for the relief of the accompanying symptoms of high blood pressure (palpitations, stiff shoulders, flushing) and of obesity, swelling, and constipation in patients who have a lot of subcutaneous fat on the abdomen and a tendency to constipation.

This medicine is used for the accompanying symptoms of high blood pressure (palpitations, stiff shoulders, flushing), obesity, swelling and constipation in patients who have a large amount of subcutaneous fat on the abdomen and a tendency to constipation.
entries.이 약은 백선(족부백선, 수부백선, 고부백선(완선), 체부백선), 피부칸: This medicine is used for ringworm (tinea pedis, tinea manuum, tinea cruris, tinea corporis), cutaneous candidiasis, tinea versicolor, and fungal infections of the nails (fingernails and toenails).
entries.이 약은 백선(체부백선, 완선, 족부백선), 피부칸디다증, 어루러기, 지: This medicine is used for tinea (tinea corporis, tinea cruris, tinea pedis), cutaneous candidiasis, tinea versicolor and the dermatomycosis of seborrheic dermatitis.
This medicine is used for cuts, scratches, and abrasions.
entries.이 약은 벤잘코늄염화물을 함유하고 있어 기관지 경련을 일으킬 수 있습니다: This medicine contains benzalkonium chloride, so it may cause bronchospasm.
entries.이 약은 벤조산나트륨을 포함하고 있으며 벤조산은 피부, 눈, 점막에 경미: This medicine contains sodium benzoate, and benzoic acid may cause mild irritation of the skin, the eyes and mucous membranes. Before using this medicine, patients sensitive to sulfites should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약은 변비 또는 변비에 따른 식욕부진(식욕감퇴), 복부팽만, 장내이상: This medicine is used for the relief of constipation or of symptoms accompanying constipation such as loss of appetite (reduced appetite), abdominal distension, abnormal intestinal fermentation, and hemorrhoids.
entries.이 약은 변비 및 변비에 따른 식욕부진, 복부팽만, 장내이상발효, 치질: This medicine is used for constipation and for the relief of loss of appetite, abdominal bloating, abnormal intestinal fermentation, and hemorrhoid symptoms associated with constipation.
entries.이 약은 변비, 만성변비, 영·유아 및 소아의 변비, 분만 후의 변비에: This medicine is used for constipation, chronic constipation, constipation in infants, young children and children, and constipation after childbirth.
entries.이 약은 변비, 변비에 따른 식욕부진(식욕감퇴), 복부팽만, 장내이상발효: This medicine is used for constipation and for loss of appetite, abdominal bloating, abnormal intestinal fermentation, and hemorrhoids associated with constipation.

entries.이 약은 변비와 변비에 따른 식욕부진(식욕감퇴), 복부팽만, 장내 이상발: This medicine is used for constipation and for loss of appetite, abdominal distension, abnormal fermentation in the intestine and hemorrhoids that accompany constipation.
entries.이 약은 변비와 변비에 수반하는 식욕부진(식욕감퇴), 복부(배부분)팽만,: This medicine is used for constipation and for the relief of loss of appetite, abdominal distension, abnormal fermentation in the intestines, and hemorrhoids that accompany constipation.
entries.이 약은 변비와 변비에 수반하는 식욕부진(식욕감퇴), 복부팽만, 장내이상: This medicine is used to relieve constipation and the loss of appetite, abdominal bloating, abnormal intestinal fermentation, and hemorrhoids that accompany constipation.
entries.이 약은 보철(의치)에 의한 염증, 아구창 등의 구강내 칸디다감염증, 치: This medicine is used to relieve inflammation caused by dentures, oral candidiasis such as thrush, gingivitis, pharyngitis and aphthous stomatitis, and for sterilization and disinfection after periodontal membrane surgery.
entries.이 약은 비누 또는 일반적인 치약 구성 성분인 음이온물질과 잘 배합되지: This medicine does not combine well with soap or with the anionic substances that are common ingredients of toothpaste, so do not use this medicine at the same time as those ingredients; after brushing your teeth, rinse your mouth with plenty of water and use this medicine at least 5 minutes later. entries.이 약은 설사, 소화기관내의 이상 발효에 의한 생성가스의 흡착 및 약물: This medicine is used for diarrhea, for the adsorption of gas produced by abnormal fermentation in the digestive tract, and as an adsorbent for emergency detoxification in cases of poisoning by medicines and chemicals.
entries.이 약은 설사, 소화기관내의 이상 발효에 의한 생성가스의 흡착과 약물 및: This medicine is used for diarrhea, for the adsorption of gas produced by abnormal fermentation in the digestive tract, and as an adsorbent for emergency detoxification in poisoning by drugs and chemicals. entries.이 약은 주사용염화나트륨용액, 흡입용염화나트륨용액, 주사용멸균증류수, 흡: This medicine may be diluted to a lower concentration with sodium chloride solution for injection, sodium chloride solution for inhalation, sterile distilled water for injection or sterile distilled water for inhalation. For nebulization therapy using a face mask, a mouthpiece or a tracheostomy, nebulize 1 to 10 mL every 2 to 6 hours. The recommended amount is 3 to 5 mL nebulized 3 to 4 times a day. Nebulization therapy using a nebulization tent or an inhaler (Croupette) is a method needed in special cases, and it is used individually according to the personal needs of the patient and the convenience of the method of administration. This method of administration requires a large volume of solution, and sometimes as much as about 300 mL may be required for a single treatment. The recommended amount should be an amount that can maintain a very dense mist-like state inside the tent or the inhaler during the treatment period. Intermittent or continuous administration over a long period is preferable. For direct instillation, give 1 to 2 mL every hour. For the regular treatment of a patient who has had a tracheostomy, give 1 to 2 mL through the tracheostomy every 1 to 4 hours. When a small plastic catheter is inserted into the trachea under local anesthesia through a direct incision to give it directly to a specific part of the bronchial tree, give 2 to 5 mL every 1 to 4 hours using a syringe connected to the catheter. When it is given using a percutaneous intrabronchial catheter, give 1 to 2 mL of this medicine every 1 to 4 hours with a syringe connected to the catheter. For diagnostic bronchography, give 1 to 2 mL 2 to 3 times by nebulization or by intrabronchial instillation before the bronchography is performed.

entries.이 약은 필요 시 2~3시간마다 각 코 안에 뿌립니다.횟수는 연령에 따라: Spray this medicine into each nostril every 2 to 3 hours as needed. The number of sprays varies according to age. Insert the nozzle into the nostril and point its tip slightly backwards. Press the pump firmly to activate the spray, spray the specified amount into both nostrils, then tilt your head to the right for 10 seconds and then to the left for 10 seconds. After that, hold your nose with your hand to close the nostrils and bend your head forward for 10 seconds. Infants may be given 1 spray, those aged 1 month to 12 months 1 to 2 sprays, those aged 1 to 2 years 1 to 3 sprays, those aged 2 to 5 years 1 to 4 sprays, those aged 5 to 8 years 1 to 5 sprays, those aged 8 to 12 years 1 to 6 sprays, and adults 1 to 8 sprays.

entries.필요 시 각각의 눈에 1회 1방울씩, 1일 수회 눈에 넣으십시오.눈에는: When necessary, instill 1 drop into each eye at a time, several times a day. To instill it, gently pull the lower eyelid down and, while looking upwards, place one drop in the lower conjunctival sac.
entries.필요 시 각각의 눈에 1회 1방울씩, 1일 수회 눈에 넣으십시오.이때 눈: When needed, instill 1 drop at a time into each eye, several times a day. To do this, gently pull the lower eyelid down and, while looking upward, put one drop into the lower conjunctival sac.
entries.필요 시 각각의 눈에 1회 1방울씩, 1일 수회 점안하십시오.점안은 아래: Instill 1 drop per dose into each eye several times a day as needed. Instill it into the lower conjunctival sac while gently pulling the lower eyelid down and looking upward.
entries.필요 시 각각의 눈에 1회 1방울씩, 1일 수회 점안합니다.아래 눈꺼풀을: If necessary, instill 1 drop into each eye at a time, several times a day. Gently pull the lower eyelid down and, while looking up, instill one drop into the lower conjunctival sac. After instillation, discard any remaining solution and the container.
entries.필요 시 증상이 있는 눈에 1~2방울씩 점안하고, 점안 후 남은 액과 용: As needed, instill 1 to 2 drops into the affected eye, and after instillation discard the remaining solution and the container.
entries.필요 시 증상이 있는 눈에 1~2방울씩 점안합니다.1회용의 경우 점안 후: When needed, instill 1 to 2 drops into the affected eye. In the case of single-use containers, discard the remaining solution and the container immediately after instillation.
entries.필요 시 증상이 있는 눈에 1~2방울씩 점안합니다.점안 후 남은 액과 용: When necessary, instill 1 to 2 drops into the eye that has symptoms. Discard the remaining solution and the container after instillation. (single-use containers only)
entries.필요 시 증상이 있는 눈에 1~2방울을 점안하고 점안 후 남은 액과 용기: When needed, instill 1 to 2 drops into the affected eye, and discard the remaining solution and the container after instillation. When using it at the same time as other eye drops, instill it with an interval of at least 15 minutes to avoid a dilution effect.
Instill 1 to 2 drops (put into the eye) as needed. Adjust the amount appropriately according to symptoms. Discard the remaining solution and the container immediately after instillation.
entries.필요시 2~3시간마다 성인은 1~8회, 영아는 1회, 1개월~12개월은: As needed, every 2 to 3 hours, adults spray 1 to 8 times, newborn infants 1 time, babies 1 month to 12 months 1 to 2 times, children 1 to 2 years 1 to 3 times, children 2 to 5 years 1 to 4 times, children 5 to 8 years 1 to 5 times, and children 8 to 12 years 1 to 6 times. Use it while lying on your side at an angle or standing with the head tilted, so that the solution does not run down into the larynx or pharynx.

As needed, every 2 to 3 hours, adults spray 1 to 8 times, infants spray once, those aged 1 month to 12 months spray 1 to 2 times, those aged 1 to 2 years spray 1 to 3 times, those aged 2 to 5 years spray 1 to 4 times, those aged 5 to 8 years spray 1 to 5 times, and those aged 8 to 12 years spray 1 to 6 times. Refer to the approved labeling for the recommended dose by age group. To keep the liquid from flowing into the larynx or pharynx, use it while lying on your side at an angle or while standing with the head tilted.
Put 1 to 2 drops into the affected eye as needed.
entries.필요시 증상이 있는 눈에 1~2방울씩 넣으십시오.용기의 개봉은 끝 부분을: When needed, instill 1 to 2 drops into the affected eye. To open the container, bend the tip fully back and forth and then pull it off.
entries.필요시 증상이 있는 눈에 1~2방울씩 점안하고, 점안 후 남은 액과 용기: As needed, instill 1 to 2 drops into the affected eye, and after instillation discard the remaining solution and the container. When using it at the same time as other eye drops, instill them at least 15 minutes apart to avoid a dilution effect.
entries.필요시 증상이 있는 눈에 1~2방울씩 점안합니다.점안 후 남은 액과 용기: As needed, instill 1 to 2 drops into the affected eye. After instillation, discard the remaining solution and the container.
entries.필요시 증상이 있는 눈에 1~2방울을 점안하고 점안 후 남은 액과 용기는: When necessary, instill 1 to 2 drops into the eye that has symptoms, and discard the remaining solution and the container after instillation. When it is used at the same time as another eye drop, leave an interval of at least 15 minutes between instillations in order to avoid a dilution effect.
entries.항생물질, 테트라사이클린, 에리트로마이신, 브롬헥신 등과 함께 복용(사용: Consult a doctor or pharmacist when it is used together with an antibiotic, tetracycline, erythromycin, bromhexine or the like.
entries.항생물질과 병용할 필요가 있는 경우에는 각각 흡입하거나 항생물질을 주사: When it is necessary to use this medicine together with an antibiotic, inhale them separately, or give the antibiotic by injection or orally.
entries.항암요법으로 고용량 메토트렉세이트를 투여중인 환자, 다른 비스테로이드성: Patients receiving high-dose methotrexate as cancer chemotherapy should not take this medicine, and do not take this medicine together with other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics. Before taking this medicine, people taking low-dose aspirin or ACE inhibitors and patients taking lithium, furosemide and thiazide diuretics, low-dose methotrexate, coumarin anticoagulants (such as warfarin), or selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.항응고제(쿠마린, 아스피린, 디피리다몰, 덱스트란, 스트렙토키나제)와 함: Do not use this medicine together with anticoagulants (coumarin, aspirin, dipyridamole, dextran, streptokinase).
If you use this medicine together with an anticoagulant, consult a doctor or pharmacist.
Do not take it together with an antipsychotic or a sleeping pill.
entries.항정신병약과 수면제(최면효과를 증가시킬 수 있습니다)와 함께 복용하지 마: Do not take this medicine together with antipsychotics or sleeping pills (they may increase the hypnotic effect).
entries.항정신병약과 수면제와 함께 복용하지 마십시오.최면효과를 증가시킬 수 있습: Do not take it together with an antipsychotic and a sleeping pill. They may increase the hypnotic effect.
entries.항히스타민제, 항세로토닌, 근이완제(파파베린)와 함께 사용 시 의사 또는: Consult a doctor or pharmacist when using it together with antihistamines, antiserotonin agents, or muscle relaxants (papaverine).
entries.해열진통제, 다른 비스테로이드성 소염진통제, 혈소판 응집 억제제(예: 아: Do not use it together with antipyretic analgesics, other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, platelet aggregation inhibitors (e.g. aspirin), oral anticoagulants (e.g. warfarin), or high-dose methotrexate.If using it together with antihypertensives, diuretics, angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors, angiotensin II antagonists, cardiac glycosides, cyclosporine, tacrolimus, glucocorticoids, lithium preparations, low-dose methotrexate, mifepristone, oral hypoglycemic agents, phenytoin, potassium-sparing diuretics, probenecid, sulfinpyrazone, quinolone antibacterials, selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors, or zidovudine, consult a doctor or pharmacist.
If you use antipyretic analgesics, consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.현기증(어지럼), 구역질, 권태감(노곤함), 호흡 이상, 발진, 발적(충: If vertigo (dizziness), nausea, malaise (lassitude), abnormal breathing, rash, redness (turning red from congestion), itching, or swelling occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.현기증, 위장장애, 상복부 통증, 메스꺼움, 설사, 홍반, 발진, 반구진: If dizziness, gastrointestinal disorders, upper abdominal pain, nausea, diarrhea, erythema, rash, maculopapular rash, hives, eczema, itching, swelling, or fluid retention in patients with heart failure occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.혈압강하제, 알코올, 중추신경억제제(수면제, 진정제, 안정제), MAO: Do not take it together with antihypertensives, alcohol, central nervous system depressants (hypnotics, sedatives, tranquilizers), MAO inhibitors, sympathomimetics, tricyclic antidepressants, guanethidine, bretylium, bethanidine, debrisoquine, methyldopa, sympathomimetic drugs (decongestants, appetite suppressants, amphetamine-type neurostimulants), and adrenergic blockers (inhibitors).

Do not take this medicine together with antihypertensives, alcohol, central nervous system depressants (sleeping pills, sedatives, tranquilizers), MAO inhibitors, sympathomimetics, tricyclic antidepressants, guanethidine, bretylium, bethanidine, debrisoquine, methyldopa, sympathomimetic drugs (decongestants, appetite suppressants, amphetamine-type stimulants) or adrenergic blocking agents (inhibitors). Administer this medicine at least 15 days after administration of an MAO inhibitor.
If you take this medicine together with antihypertensive medicines or antidepressants, consult a doctor or pharmacist.
Do not use this medicine together with antihypertensives or antidepressants.
entries.혈액학적 이상 반응 등이 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고 의사 또는: If hematological adverse reactions occur, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.혈액학적 이상반응이 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고 의사 또는 약사와: If hematological adverse reactions occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.혈청, 농 등의 유기물질, 비누류는 이 약의 살균작용을 약화시키므로 충분: Organic substances such as serum and pus, and soaps, weaken the disinfectant action of this medicine, so wash them off thoroughly before use.
entries.호흡곤란, 온몸이 붉어짐, 혈관부기, 두드러기 등의 쇽 증상 혹은 천식발: If shock symptoms such as difficulty breathing, reddening of the whole body, swelling of the blood vessels, or urticaria, or asthma attacks, thrombocytopenia, granulocytopenia, hemolytic anemia, methemoglobinemia, reduced platelet function such as prolonged bleeding time, cyanosis, hypersensitivity symptoms such as facial swelling, sweating, or low blood pressure, nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, gastrointestinal bleeding, peptic ulcer, perforation, rash, mucocutaneous ocular syndrome (Stevens-Johnson syndrome), toxic epidermal necrolysis (Lyell's syndrome), elevated AST, elevated ALT, or fixed drug eruption occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

If shock symptoms such as difficulty breathing, reddening of the whole body, angioedema, or urticaria, or an asthma attack, thrombocytopenia, granulocytopenia, hemolytic anemia, methemoglobinemia, decreased platelet function (prolonged bleeding time), or hypersensitivity symptoms such as cyanosis, facial swelling, sweating, or low blood pressure, or nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, gastrointestinal bleeding, peptic ulcer, perforation, rash, Stevens-Johnson syndrome (mucocutaneous ocular syndrome), toxic epidermal necrolysis (Lyell's syndrome), elevated AST, elevated ALT, or fixed drug eruption occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.환부를 깨끗이 씻어 내고 1일 2회씩, 아침, 저녁으로 환부에 충분한 양: Wash the affected area clean and apply a sufficient amount to the affected area 2 times in 1 day, in the morning and in the evening.
After washing the affected area, apply this medicine 1 to several times a day and then rub it in thoroughly.
After washing the affected area, apply an appropriate amount once or several times a day.
entries.환부의 가장자리까지 충분히 적용할 수 있는 적당량으로 하여 1일 5회씩,: Use an amount sufficient to cover the affected area up to its edges, 5 times a day for 5 days. Start treatment as soon as possible as soon as the first symptoms and signs appear.
entries.흔하게 건조감, 피부 벗겨짐, 때때로 일시적인 작열감(화끈감), 저림,: If a feeling of dryness or peeling of the skin, which are common, a temporary burning sensation (a hot feeling) or numbness, which occur occasionally, or, rarely, erythema (red spots), pigmentation or the symptoms and signs of inflammation occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Because of systemic absorption, reversible suppression of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis, Cushing's syndrome, hyperglycemia, diabetes and visual disturbance may occur.
entries.흔하게 건조감, 피부 벗겨짐, 때때로 일시적인 작열감, 저림, 드물게 홍: If commonly a feeling of dryness or peeling of the skin, occasionally a temporary burning sensation or numbness, rarely erythema, pigmentation, inflammation, bacterial (impetigo contagiosa, folliculitis, etc.) or fungal (candidiasis, tinea, etc.) skin infections, general skin symptoms (folliculitis, boils, skin irritation, stinging pain, fever, a burning sensation, rash, redness, flushing, itching, dry skin, pustular dermatitis, allergic contact dermatitis, heat rash, miliaria, worsening of wounds, bedsores, pustulosis), or, when it is used on the eyelid skin, increased intraocular pressure or glaucoma, or blurred vision of unknown frequency occurs, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

entries.흥분(특히 어린이), 현저한 졸음, 불안, 어지러움 또는 불면증, 인후(: If excitement (especially in children), marked drowsiness, anxiety, dizziness or insomnia occur, if a sore throat continues for 2 days or more or is accompanied by headache, fever, rash, nausea or vomiting, if severe skin adverse reactions such as acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis (AGEP), fever, erythema and numerous small pustules occur, or if ischemic colitis (sudden abdominal pain, rectal bleeding, etc.) occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
